entries.烈: Phono-semantic compound: 列 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.烊: Originally an alternative form (異體字) of 煬. Phono-semantic compound: 火 (flame, semantic) + 羊 (phonetic).
entries.烏: Pictogram – a bird. Compare 鳥, of similar development. See also the original version of its variant 於.
entries.烐: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 舟 (phonetic).
entries.烖: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (semantic) + 𢦏 (disaster, phonetic); a form of 𢦏 with 火 added, the form used in the seal script.
entries.烙: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.烝: Compound ideogram: 丞 (to raise, phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.烢: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 宅 (phonetic).
entries.烯: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 希 (phonetic).
entries.烷: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 完 (full; complete, phonetic). 火 is a common radical used for names of hydrocarbons.
entries.烹: Phono-semantic compound: 亨 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.烽: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 夆 (phonetic).
entries.焀: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 谷 (phonetic)
entries.焉: A ligature (合字) of 於是. After 焉 became a single morpheme, the ligature came to be seen as a new character and was simplified. By the seal small seal script, the 日 part from 是 had been removed, and the 烏 (於) was reduced to its bottom half.
entries.焓: Compound ideogram: 火 (fire, semantic) + 含 (to contain inside, phonetic).
entries.焗: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 局 (phonetic).
entries.焙: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 咅 (phonetic)
entries.焜: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 昆 (phonetic).
entries.焦: Zhou Zhongbing (2024): Phono-semantic compound: 隹 (bird, semantic) + 小 (phonetic) — original form of 鷦. During the Warring States period, 小 corrupted into 火, after which it was borrowed to represent 焦.
entries.焰: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 臽 (phonetic)
entries.然:
Phono-semantic compound: 肰 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic) – to burn. The derivative 燃 preserves the original word.

In the modern form, the top-left component 肉 has been turned on its side, appearing more like 夕 with an extra stroke (𱼀); compare 祭, 將.
entries.煉: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 柬 (phonetic).
entries.煌: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 皇 (phonetic).
entries.煎: Phono-semantic compound: 前 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.煑: Phono-semantic compound: 者 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic) – to cook over a fire.
entries.煓: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 耑 (phonetic).
entries.煕: Phono-semantic compound: 巸 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic)
entries.煖: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (sun, semantic) + 爰 (phonetic). Originally has the same pronunciation and meaning as 暄.
entries.煙: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 垔 (phonetic).
entries.煤: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 某 (phonetic).
entries.煥: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 奐 (phonetic).
entries.煦: Phono-semantic compound: 昫 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.照: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 昭 (phonetic).
entries.煬: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 昜 (phonetic).
entries.煮: Phono-semantic compound: 者 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic) – to cook over a fire.
entries.煴:
An unorthodox variant Simplified from 熅. which can be found in various historical dictionaries. 

Eventually adopted as an official form by the People's Republic of China in 1965 based on the Xin Zixing (新字形) standardized form of characters.
entries.煽: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 扇 (phonetic).
entries.熊:
According to Shuowen, Phono-semantic compound: 能 (bear, semantic) + 炎 (phonetic).

This character originally represented an onomatopoetic word (熊熊). Later its semantic component 能, the character for the Old Chinese word "bear", was borrowed for another word. This character thus began to represent the word "bear" instead.
entries.熏: In the original version, it is 東 with four dots inside perhaps to indicate grass and herbs inside the tied bag. Later, fire 火 (or 炎) at the bottom was added. The original meaning is "smoked herbs". Two semi-conservative versions are 𡴦 and 𡽽. Today, the original meaning is preserved in 薰. Unrelated to 黑.
entries.熒: Pictogram – The protoform is 𤇾. 𤇾 is a pictogram of two intersecting torches, meaning the fire light. In Qin and Han, the crossing of the torches "乂" became "冂", and "𤇾" is no longer used as independent character as a third "火" (fire) was added into "𤇾". Thus, "熒" was formed.
entries.熔: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 容 (phonetic)
entries.熙: Phono-semantic compound: 巸 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.熜: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 悤 (phonetic)
entries.熟: Compound ideogram: 孰 (cooked; ripe, phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic) – cooked with fire.
entries.熠: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 習 (phonetic).
entries.熱: Phono-semantic compound: 埶 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.熲: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 頃 (phonetic)
entries.熾: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 戠 (phonetic).
entries.燂: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 覃 (phonetic).
entries.燃: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 然 (phonetic) – burn with fire. Originally 然, but because it was phonetically borrowed for abstract senses, 火 was added for differentiation.
entries.燅: Phono-semantic compound: 坴 (semantic) + 炎 (hot, phonetic)
entries.燇: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 尊 (phonetic)
entries.燈: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (candlelight, semantic) + 登 (phonetic).
entries.燎: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.燒: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic).
entries.燔: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 番 (phonetic).
entries.燖: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 尋 (phonetic).
entries.營: Phono-semantic compound: 熒 (phonetic) + 宮 (palace, semantic), depicting a person working all night with a light on his house.
entries.燥: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 喿 (phonetic).
entries.燦: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 粲 (phonetic)
entries.燧: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 遂 (phonetic).
entries.燬: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 毀 (phonetic).
entries.燮:
In the oracle bone script, an Compound ideogram: a hand (又) holding an object (?) among three or more fires (火). Meaning and significance uncertain.

Various hypotheses exist: possibly poking at firewood, holding a tool inside flames, lighting fires with a torch, etc.

Later, an Compound ideogram: 又 (hand) + 辛 (tool) + 炏 (fire). In the small seal script, the 辛 component came to be written 言, giving rise to the modern form.
entries.燹: Compound ideogram – - a group of pigs (豩) fleeing from a fire (火). The bronze script form has a hand with a stick (攴), indicating that the fire would have been started on purpose, in manner to get rid of the pigs. The large seal script form also has what looks like 爾 on the right side.
entries.燻: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 熏 (phonetic).
entries.燾: Phono-semantic compound: 壽 (phonetic) + 火 (fire, semantic).
entries.燿: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 翟 (phonetic).
entries.爁: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 監 (phonetic)
entries.爆: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (semantic) + 暴 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component originally meant "violence", hence it could add part of the meaning. A conservative variant is 𤒺; later it was stylized into 爆.
entries.爊:
Simplified from 𤏶.

Originally written 𤏶, see there for more.
entries.爍: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 樂 (phonetic).
entries.爐: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 盧 (phonetic). Originally written 盧, see there for more.
entries.爒: Phono-semantic compound: 炙 (burn, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.爛: Phono-semantic compound: 火 (fire, semantic) + 闌 (phonetic).
entries.爨:
A relatively late-appearing character, first found in bamboo slips.

Compound ideogram: 𦥑 (two hands) + 鬲 (cooking vessel) + 冂 (stove opening) + 林 (firewood) + 廾 (two hands) + 火 (fire) + 廾 (two hands) + 火 (fire) – hands holding a cooking vessel over a stove, and hands putting firewood in the stove over a fire.
entries.爪: Pictogram – a hand grabbing from above (in earlier forms from side); compare 手, 寸, 九. Though it sometimes indicates a claw, the pictogram in actuality depicts a human hand.
entries.爭: Pictogram – two hands on a plowshare. The two hands are still visibile on top of the character (爪 and 彐), while the plowshare looks like a vertical hook in modern writing.
entries.爯: Compound ideogram: 爪 (hand) + 冉 (fish) – a hand holding a fish.
entries.爰:
Compound ideogram: 爪 (hand) + 丨 + 又 (hand) – two hands holding or pulling something, possibly indicating “to pull”, the original form of 援.

The middle component has historically taken on various forms.
entries.爱: A variant of 愛, replacing the lower-half component 𢖻 with 友.
entries.爲: Originally an Compound ideogram: 又 (hand) + 象 (elephant). See 為 for the full etymology and historical forms.
entries.爵: Pictogram – of an alcohol vessel in the shape of a sparrow. Many variants showed a hand (又) holding it, now written as 寸. In the seal script form 𢋺*, the topmost and middle sections of the vessel are combined, while the legs have corrupted into 鬯. In the modern form, the top and middle sections of the vessel are separated into 爫 and 罒* respectively. The bottom left sub-component similar to 艮 is a simplification of 鬯.
entries.父: Pictogram – A hand holding a stone blade, referring to a man working with a stone axe.
entries.爸: Phono-semantic compound: 父 (father, semantic) + 巴 (phonetic).
entries.爹: Phono-semantic compound: 父 (father, semantic) + 多 (phonetic).
entries.爺: Phono-semantic compound: 父 (father, semantic) + 耶 (phonetic).
entries.爽: Compound ideogram: 大 + 㸚 – bright.
entries.爾: Pictogram – cloth on a loom, with threads crossing – original form of 檷. Later phonetically borrowed as an instance of Phonetic loan – to represent 爾.
entries.爿:
Simplified from 片.

Pictogram – a bed. The original form of 牀. In the character 臧, it appears as a contracted form.
entries.牀: Phono-semantic compound: 爿 (bed, phonetic) + 木 (wood, semantic). 爿 originally referred to this word, 木 was added later.
entries.牆:
Simplified from 蘠.

Phono-semantic compound: 爿 (phonetic) + 嗇 (wheat in a granary, semantic).
entries.片:
Mirror image of 爿, which is the pictogram of a bed.

Shuowen: half of 木 to denote “to pare; to slice”; but this interpretation is not based on oracle bones and bronzes.
entries.牙: The pictogram of a pair of elephant tusks. According to Xu Shen, this pictogram was used to indicate human molars but not front teeth/incisors (齒).
entries.牛: Pictogram – of a bull's head, with two horns and two ears. Perhaps unrelated to 告; unrelated to 先.
entries.牝: Compound ideogram: 牛 (cattle) + 匕 (female genital).
entries.牟: Ideogram: An ox (牛) with a symbol (now 厶) to represent its lowing.
entries.牡: Compound ideogram: 牛 (cattle) + 丄. Various explanations exist, some propose 丄 (here unrelated to 上) depicts a penis to represent “male”. Later 丄 came to be written 土. See also the etymology of this character.
entries.牢: Compound ideogram: 宀 (pen; animal yard) + 牛 (cow)
entries.牧: Compound ideogram: 牛 (cow) + 攴 (a whip) – to herd.
entries.牯: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cow, semantic) + 古 (phonetic)
entries.牲: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cow, semantic) + 生 (phonetic).
entries.特: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (ox, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic) – large bull.
entries.牾: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cow, semantic) + 吾 (phonetic)
entries.犀: Phono-semantic compound: 尾 (phonetic) + 牛 (ox, semantic).
entries.犁: Phono-semantic compound: 利 (phonetic) + 牛 (cow, semantic)
entries.犅: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (ox, semantic) + 岡 (phonetic).
entries.犈: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cattle, semantic) + 卷 (phonetic).
entries.犋: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cattle, semantic) + 具 (phonetic).
entries.犏: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cow, semantic) + 扁 (phonetic).
entries.犒: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (cow, semantic) + 高 (phonetic).
entries.犟: Phono-semantic compound: 強 (phonetic) + 牛 (cattle, semantic).
entries.犦: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (bull, cow, semantic) + 暴 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component also means "to stick out, to bulge; to expose", so it could add part of the meaning. A conservative version is 𤜌; later, the character was stylized into 犦.
entries.犧: Phono-semantic compound: 牛 (ox, semantic) + 羲 (phonetic).
entries.犩: Phono-semantic compound: 魏 (phonetic) + 牛 (bull, semantic).
entries.犬: Pictogram – the side view of a dog.
entries.犮: Compound ideogram: 犬 (dog) + 丿. According to Shuowen Jiezi, it represents a walking dog.
entries.犴: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 干 (phonetic).
entries.犵: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 乞 (phonetic)
entries.犼: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (canine, semantic) + 孔 (phonetic)
entries.狂: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 㞷 (phonetic). The latter is the ancient form of 往.
entries.狃: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 丑 (animal claw, phonetic) – animal tracks.
entries.狎: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 甲 (phonetic).
entries.狐: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 瓜 (phonetic).
entries.狒: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 弗 (phonetic).
entries.狗: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 句 (phonetic).
entries.狦: Shuowen: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 刪 (phonetic)
entries.狩: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 守 (phonetic).
entries.狫: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 老 (phonetic) (see also Graphic pejoratives in written Chinese#Dog radical)
entries.狴: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 坒 (phonetic).
entries.狸: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 里 (phonetic). Originally an unorthodox variant (俗字) of the character 貍.
entries.狹: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 夾 (phonetic).
entries.狺:
Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 言 (phonetic).

May have originally been written 㹞, in which case it is a Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 斤 (phonetic).
entries.狽: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 貝 (phonetic).
entries.狾: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog; canine; beast, semantic) + 折 (phonetic).
entries.猁: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 利 (phonetic).
entries.猊: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 兒 (phonetic)
entries.猒:
In bronze inscriptions, Compound ideogram: a dog 犬 eating 口 meat ⺼ – "satisfied".

In the modern form, 口 has corrupted into 甘 and later 日.
entries.猓: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 果 (phonetic)
entries.猖: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 昌 (phonetic).
entries.猙: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 爭 (phonetic).
entries.猚:
Simplified from 犬.

Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (phonetic) + 隹 (bird, semantic)
entries.猞: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 舍 (phonetic).
entries.猣: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 㚇 (phonetic).
entries.猪: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 者 (phonetic).
entries.猶: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 酋 (phonetic) – a kind of monkey.
entries.猹: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 查 (phonetic).
entries.獄: Compound ideogram: 㹜 (two dogs) + 言 (words) (㹜 = 犭 + 犬, two forms of “dog”). A place where dogs are barking (言) at each other, a jail with guard dogs.
entries.獅: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog; beast, semantic) + 師 (phonetic).
entries.獍: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 竟 (phonetic).
entries.獎: Phono-semantic compound: 將 (phonetic) + 犬 (dog, semantic). The significance of 犬 is unclear; cf. the same radical in 獻. Perhaps it's a reference to guiding a dog using one's voice.
entries.獑: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 斬 (phonetic).
entries.獚: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 黃 (phonetic).
entries.獛: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 菐 (phonetic)
entries.獜: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 粦 (phonetic)
entries.獞: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 童 (phonetic).
entries.獟: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic)
entries.獠: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (beast, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.獩: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 歲 (phonetic).
entries.獲: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 蒦 (to catch, phonetic) — according to Kōjien, to hunt and catch animals with a dog.
entries.獶: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 憂 (phonetic).
entries.獸: Compound ideogram: 單 (hunting weapon) + 犬 (dog) – "hunting". 口 was added later (see 嘼).
entries.獹: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 盧 (phonetic)
entries.獺: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 賴 (phonetic)
entries.獻: Phono-semantic compound: 鬳 (phonetic) + 犬 (dog, semantic).
entries.玃: Phono-semantic compound: 犬 (dog, semantic) + 矍 (phonetic).
entries.玆: 玄 (deep; profound). Its variation 𢆶 derives from the duplication of the Kangxi radical 幺 yāo.
entries.率: Pictogram – according to Xu Shen, a net to capture birds. 冫幺冫is the net, and the top and bottom is the stick. But in the original version, the horizontal stroke in the lower part is missing, therefore the whole character should represent a rope, 繂.
entries.玈: Phono-semantic compound: 玄 (deep, mysterious, semantic) + 旅 (phonetic).
entries.玉:
The character's shape was historically very similar to 王; a dot was introduced to differentiate the two.

Pictogram: a picture of a cong (琮), a sort of ritual jade totem.

It is also interpreted as three pieces of jade strung together on a string.

It is also used as a simplification of 或.
entries.王:
Pictogram – of a ritual axe made perhaps of jade, symbols of the king's power. A ceremonial axe was kept near the throne, and was used for performing rituals in ancient China.

The traditional interpretation (most likely a folk etymology given the original appearance of the character) is that the character metaphorically indicates the king or emperor according to the ancient Chinese thought: three horizontal strokes represent Heaven, Man and Earth, and the vertical stroke is the king or emperor, the one who connects them together. However, compare 天 (a man with a horizontal stroke above his head to indicate the sky).

Unrelated to 玉 and 主; partly related to 士 (a war axe and, perhaps, sometimes a variant of 王), to 戉 (an axe drawn vertically), to the inner component of 匡, and to the right component of 往 (< 𢓸).
entries.玠: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 介 (phonetic).
entries.玡: Phono-semantic compound: 王 (jade, semantic) + 牙 (phonetic).
entries.玨: Compound ideogram: 玉 (jade) + 玉 (jade). 玉 stylized as 王. Unrelated to the top component of 豐.
entries.玩: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 元 (phonetic) – ancient toys made of jade.
entries.玫: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 文 (phonetic)
entries.环:
Unorthodox variant Simplified from 環. and found in the Ming dynasty orthographic dictionary 《字學三正》.

Eventually adopted as an official simplified character by the People's Republic of China in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme.
entries.玲: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 令 (phonetic).
entries.玳: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 代 (phonetic).
entries.珀: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 白 (phonetic).
entries.珂: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 可 (phonetic).
entries.珈: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 加 (phonetic).
entries.珍: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (semantic) + 㐱 (phonetic). Originally meant a rich, robust gemstone (玉), and then also developed the meaning of "rare".
entries.珓: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 交 (phonetic).
entries.珕: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 劦 (phonetic).
entries.珞: Phono-semantic compound: 王 (jade, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.珠: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 朱 (phonetic).
entries.珥: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 耳 (phonetic).
entries.珦: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 向 (phonetic).
entries.珧: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.珩: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 行 (phonetic).
entries.珪: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 圭 (phonetic).
entries.珬: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 戌 (phonetic).
entries.班: Compound ideogram: 珏 (pieces of jade) + 刀 (knife) – to cut jade to pieces with knife. The pieces of jade appear as a more conservative version 玨. The knife in the middle is well visibile in the conservative variant 𤤻. Unrelated to 师.
entries.珺: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 君 (phonetic).
entries.現: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 見 (phonetic) — to appear.
entries.球: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 求 (phonetic).
entries.琅: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 良 (phonetic)
entries.理:
Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 里 (phonetic).

According to Shuowen Jiezi, the character meant “to polish jade”. The current meaning “to order, tidy up” may be derived from it.
entries.琇: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 秀 (phonetic).
entries.琈: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 孚 (phonetic).
entries.琉: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 㐬 (phonetic).
entries.琊: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 邪 (phonetic)

entries.琼: Corrupted from 琁 (per 简化字源, 1999).
entries.琿: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).

entries.瑏: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 穿 (phonetic).

entries.瑞: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 耑 (phonetic).
entries.瑟: Phono-semantic compound: 珡 (musical instrument, semantic) + 必 (phonetic). 珡 has been simplified into the unrelated 玨.
entries.瑠: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 留 (phonetic).
entries.瑢: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 容 (phonetic)
entries.瑩: Phono-semantic compound: 熒 (phonetic) + 玉 (jade, semantic).
entries.瑪: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 馬 (phonetic).

entries.瑰: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 鬼 (phonetic).
entries.瑳: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 差 (phonetic).
entries.璁: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 悤 (phonetic)

entries.璣: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 幾 (phonetic).
entries.璦: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 愛 (phonetic).
entries.璧: Phono-semantic compound: 辟 (phonetic) + 玉 (semantic) – a type of jade.
entries.璨: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 粲 (phonetic).
entries.璩: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 豦 (phonetic).
entries.璯: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 會 (phonetic).
entries.環: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 睘 (phonetic).
entries.璽: From 壐. Phono-semantic compound: 爾 (phonetic) + 玉 (jade, semantic).
entries.璿: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 睿 (phonetic)
entries.瓅: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 樂 (phonetic).
entries.瓊: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 夐 (phonetic).
entries.瓌: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 褱 (phonetic).
entries.瓏: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 龍 (dragon, phonetic)
entries.瓜: Pictogram – - a pictograph of a melon suspended by its vines.
entries.瓞: Phono-semantic compound: 瓜 (melon, semantic) + 失 (phonetic).
entries.瓣: Phono-semantic compound: 辡 (phonetic) + 瓜 (melon, semantic) — melon seeds.
entries.瓤: Phono-semantic compound: 襄 (phonetic) + 瓜 (gourd, semantic).
entries.瓦: Pictogram – fired earthenware pottery, or a tile.
entries.瓩: Borrowed from Japanese. Ultimately an Compound ideogram: 瓦 (watt) + 千 (one thousand).
entries.瓶:
Phono-semantic compound: 并 (phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic). According to the radical, it originally indicates an earthenware vessel, i.e., not a glass bottle. It had a long slender neck opening up to a narrow mouth. However, 瓶 was also part of ritual bronzes in ancient China, hence it was made of bronze when used during rituals.

Today, it indicates bottles of any kind and dimension.
entries.瓷: Phono-semantic compound: 次 (phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic).
entries.瓺: Phono-semantic compound: 長 (phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic)
entries.瓻: Phono-semantic compound: 稀 (phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic)
entries.甌: Phono-semantic compound: 區 (vessel, phonetic) + 瓦 (pottery, semantic).
entries.甍: Phono-semantic compound: 夢 (phonetic) + 瓦 (roof tile, semantic).
entries.甏: Phono-semantic compound: 彭 (phonetic) + 瓦 (fired earthenware pottery, semantic).
entries.甕: Phono-semantic compound: 雍 (phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic).
entries.甗:
Initially a Pictogram – of a two-part cooking vessel. Later 虍 was added and the cooking vessel became 鬲, producing 鬳.

In the current form, an Compound ideogram: 鬳 (cooking vessel, phonetic) + 瓦 (earthenware, semantic).
entries.甘: Ideogram – something sweet in an open mouth; the original drawing is 𠁿. Original form of 含. See also 敢, 旨, 香, and 音.
entries.甜: Compound ideogram: 舌 (tongue) + 甘 (sweet). Rearrangement of 甛.
entries.生: Compound ideogram: 屮 (bud) + 一 (ground) – sprouting from the ground. A conservative version is 𤯓, which is unrelated to 㞷 (匩 > 匡) and 𡴀 > 丰.
entries.產: Phono-semantic compound: 彥 (phonetic) + 生 (to be born, semantic).
entries.甦: Variant form of 蘇. Compound ideogram: from 更生.
entries.用: Phono-semantic compound: formed by adding a handle to 同.
entries.甪: Original version of 角 (Zihui), which represents a horn. Unrelated to the bottom part of 備, which represents a quiver.
entries.甬: Pictogram – a bronze bell. In the bronze inscription, the lower part evolved into 用, which serves as a phonetic component. Similar but unrelated to 用 and 角.
entries.田:
Pictogram – pictographic representation of a field divided into four sections. See the original version of 甫 and 里.

Sometimes it means mask. See 異 and 鬼. Unrelated to 思, 黄, 果, 由, 甲, and perhaps 番.
entries.由:
Pictogram – pictogram of new shoots or leaves growing from 木; possibly the original graph of 㽕, with its upper part later extracted as 由.

Alternatively interpreted as the upper part of the oracle-bone form of 柚 (“pomelo”), depicting the fruit itself.
entries.甲: Pictogram: A pictogram of the protective hard shell, carapace, or scales of an animal, or a suit of armor made of connected plates.
entries.申: Pictogram – a bolt of lightning. Original character of 電 and 神.
entries.甶: Pictogram – face/head of a ghost/spirit/demon, according to the Shuowen. However, it could be a mask.
entries.男: Compound ideogram: 田 (field) + 力 (strength) – man providing the strength for agricultural and/or other kinds of (physical) labour on a field.
entries.甸: Phono-semantic compound: 人 (person, semantic) + 田 (field, phonetic).
entries.甹: Uncertain. Original meaning unclear. Used early on to mean “chivalrous person”.
entries.町: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 丁 (phonetic)
entries.画: Seemingly from 畵 with 𦘒 omitted.
entries.畀:
In the oracle bone script, it was a Pictogram – of an arrow with a flat arrowhead (cf. 矢, an arrow) – original character of 錍.

In the bronze script, a dot was added to the centre, which later became a short line. The bottom of the glyph eventually corrupted into 廾 or 丌. On the basis of the latter shape, Shuowen erroneously interprets the character as a Phono-semantic compound: 甶 (phonetic) + 丌 (pedestal, semantic).
entries.畈: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 反 (phonetic).
entries.界: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 介 (phonetic).
entries.畏:
Phono-semantic compound: 卜 (semantic) + 鬼 (phonetic). In the bronze inscriptions, 心 and 攴 were sometimes added. During the Warring States period, the 卜 corrupted into 止.

Hsiao-ting Li: In oracle bone script form, this character depicts a ghost 鬼 standing and holding a stick.

Shuowen mistakes the small seal glyph as a ghost head (甶) with part of a tiger, including its claw.
entries.畔: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 半 (phonetic).
entries.留: In bronze inscriptions, Phono-semantic compound: 卯 (phonetic) + 田 (field, semantic). Later in small seal script, 丣 (phonetic) + 田 (semantic).
entries.畜:
Pictogram: 玄 (rope tying the bag of feed) + 田 (bag of feed) – a bag of feed, hence livestock.

Alternatively, 玄 (rope) + 田 or 囿 (pen; fold; enclosure) – tying animals and raising them in the enclosure.
entries.畝: Originally written as 畮, a Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 每 (phonetic). The phonetic component 每 was later replaced with 又, now written as the new phonetic component 久. The component 十 was added above 田 in the Warring States period and was later corrupted into 亠 in clerical script.
entries.畢: Compound ideogram: 田 (field) + 𠦒 (net) – a net used for hunting in the field. Compare with 單
entries.略: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 各 (phonetic) – to walk around a field (to outline it).
entries.番:
Phono-semantic compound: 釆 (phonetic) + 田 (semantic). Original meaning is unclear. 

Shuowen instead interprets it as a pictogram of an animal's footprint; original form of 蹯.

Tadashi Takada (高田忠周): a pictogram of some seeds on the palm of an open hand, which conveys the concept of "spreading"; original form of 播.

Neither Shuowen nor Tadashi Takada interpret the bottom component as representing a field.
entries.畫:
Li Shoukui (2016): Phono-semantic compound: 聿 (brush, semantic) + 規 (phonetic). 規 appears in the oracle bone script in its pictographic protoform resembling a 乂. During the Western Zhou period, 周 was added as seen in the bronze inscriptions.

Traditionally explained as an ideogrammic compound of 聿 ("brush") + 画 ("a field (田) enclosed on four sides"). However, the ancient scripts do not depict a field.

Stroke (CJK character)
entries.畱: Phono-semantic compound: 丣 (phonetic) + 田 (field, semantic)
entries.畳: Japanese shinjitai Simplified from 疊. In current form 田 + 冝.
entries.當: Phono-semantic compound: 尚 (phonetic) + 田 (field, semantic) – fields facing each other.
entries.畹: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 宛 (phonetic).
entries.畺: Compound ideogram: 三 (boundaries) + 畕 (fields) — divided fields, now written 疆. The original character exists as a phonetic component.
entries.疃:
Simplified from 畽.

Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 童 (phonetic).
entries.疄: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 粦 (phonetic).
entries.疆: Phono-semantic compound: 土 (earth, semantic) + 彊 (phonetic).
entries.疇: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 壽 (phonetic).
entries.疈:
Phono-semantic compound: 㽬 (phonetic) + 刀 (knife, semantic).

Large seal script of 副.
entries.疊:
畾 + 宜 – a pile.

Originally as 曡, with 晶 on top. Shuowen commented that the shape change was promoted by the emperor of the short-lived Xin Dynasty, who deemed the use of three "suns" (日) in this character too empowering - compared to three "fields" (田).
entries.疋: Pictogram – a foot 止 with a leg/thigh on top; the pictogram is similar to 足. Unrelated with the bottom part of 是, which is 止 on oracle bones.
entries.疌: According to Shuowen, Phono-semantic compound: 屮 (phonetic) + 又 (hand, semantic) + 止 (foot, semantic)
entries.疐:
Unclear. Various explanations exist. Original meaning uncertain.

Several related forms can be found in the oracle bone scripts. Generally considered to be an Compound ideogram – related to vegetation in some way.

Variously thought to derive from 田 with 人 and/or 屮, from 曾 with a seedling, 麥, from 𠌶 or 萼, among others.

Sometimes 止 was added to the bottom, which is inherited in later forms.
entries.疒: Pictogram – a person lying in bed. Original form of 疾.
entries.疔: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 丁 (phonetic).
entries.疕: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 匕 (phonetic)
entries.疙: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 乞 (phonetic).
entries.疛: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 肘 (phonetic).
entries.疝: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 山 (phonetic).
entries.疣: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 尤 (phonetic).
entries.疫: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 役 (phonetic).
entries.疲: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sick, semantic) + 皮 (phonetic) – sick and tired.
entries.疻: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (to be sick, semantic) + 只 (phonetic).
entries.疼: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 冬 (phonetic).
entries.疽: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 且 (phonetic)
entries.疾:
Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, phonetic) + 疾 (fast, phonetic). The two characters, originally representing different words, have merged into one character representing both senses.

The oracle glyph of ⿰大矢 depicts an arrow flying towards a person - "fast". The "illness" sense preserves the original meaning of 疒. The 亠 component represents the person found in both pictograms.
entries.痀: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 句 (phonetic).
entries.病: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 丙 (phonetic) – illness. Note that 丙 also means “fire”, hence connotations of “lying feverishly in bed”.
entries.症: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 正 (phonetic).
entries.痍: Phono-semantic compound: 夷 (phonetic) + 疒 (disease, semantic).
entries.痒: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 羊 (phonetic).
entries.痔: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic)
entries.痘: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 豆 (bean, phonetic) - a disease causing bean-shaped skin eruption.
entries.痛: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 甬 (phonetic). The character conveys the meaning of "pain" or "to hurt."
entries.痟: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 肖 (phonetic).
entries.痠: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness; disease, semantic) + 夋 (phonetic).
entries.痢: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 利 (phonetic) – a kind of illness.
entries.痧: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness; disease, semantic) + 沙 (phonetic).
entries.痮: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 長 (phonetic)
entries.痰: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 炎 (phonetic).
entries.痹: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 畀 (phonetic).
entries.痺: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 卑 (phonetic).
entries.痼: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 固 (phonetic).
entries.痾: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 阿 (phonetic).
entries.瘀: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 於 (phonetic).
entries.瘈: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness; disease, semantic) + 契 (phonetic).
entries.瘍: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 昜 (phonetic).
entries.瘕: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 叚 (phonetic).
entries.瘞: Phono-semantic compound: 㾜 (phonetic) + 土 (earth, semantic).
entries.瘠: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 脊 (phonetic)
entries.瘤: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 留 (phonetic).
entries.瘩: Considered a 後起字. Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 荅 (phonetic).
entries.瘴: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 章 (phonetic)
entries.瘸: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 加 (phonetic) + 肉 (flesh, semantic).
entries.療: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.癆: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sickness, semantic) + 勞 (phonetic).
entries.癇: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 閒 (phonetic).
entries.癌: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 嵒 (rock, phonetic); 嵒 is a variant of 岩.
entries.癎: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 間 (phonetic).
entries.癐: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (sick; ill, semantic) + 會 (phonetic).
entries.癔: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 意 (phonetic)
entries.癢: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 養 (phonetic).
entries.癤: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 節 (phonetic).
entries.癥: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 徵 (phonetic)
entries.癦: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 墨 (phonetic).
entries.癧: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 歷 (phonetic).
entries.癭: Pictogram: a woman with outgrowth on her neck — a goitre. Later, a Phono-semantic compound: 病 (semantic) + 嬰 (phonetic); the 嬰 in turn has this character's protoform as its phonetic component, as can be seen in the bronze inscriptions.
entries.癯: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness; injury; disability, semantic) + 瞿 (phonetic)
entries.癰: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (disease, semantic) + 雝 (phonetic).
entries.癲: Phono-semantic compound: 疒 (illness, semantic) + 顛 (phonetic).
entries.癹: Compound ideogram: 癶 (two outstretched feet, phonetic) + 殳 (hand with stick) – To beat or cut grass. Possibly the original form of 撥.
entries.登: Compound ideogram: 癶 (left and right feet) + 豆 (pictogrammic of raised object; stepping stone). The two hands at the bottom disappeared, but they are retained in the conservative variant 𤼷.
entries.皀: Pictogram – - a bowl of rice on a stand. The pictogram is part of the radical 食. Unrelated to 良 and 旨.
entries.皂: Variant form of 皁, in turn a variant form of 早 retaining its original sense "acorn" (see there for more).
entries.皆:
Oracle bone script: Phono-semantic compound: 虍 (semantic) + 几 (phonetic) + 口 (semantic).

Bronze script: Phono-semantic compound: 比 (semantic) + 甘 (phonetic).

The bottom component later corrupted into 白, leading to the Shuowen reinterpretation of Compound ideogram: 比 + 白.
entries.皇:
Pictogram – the oracle bone form depicts a single plume of a 鳳凰 (peacock); a phonetic 王 was later added, giving Phono-semantic compound: 𤼽 (semantic) + 王 (phonetic).See also 䍿. In the oracle bone inscriptions the character occurs as a personal or clan name and is recorded campaigning with 雀.

Belongs to a word family associated with radiant light, great size, vivid colour, and resonant sound.
entries.皈: Considered a 後起字. Originally 𦤇, which is an Compound ideogram: 自 (self) + 反 (to return; to move back). Later 自 was corrupted into 白.
entries.皋:
Simplified from 臯.

Compound ideogram: 白 (white, bright) + 夲 (to advance), although the connection to the modern meaning is unclear.
entries.皓: Phono-semantic compound: 白 (white, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.皚: Phono-semantic compound: 白 (white, semantic) + 豈 (phonetic).
entries.皮:
Pictogram – a hand (又) stripping the fur from an animal pelt (similar to 革). The pelt moved to the top left and became abstracted.

The character 叚 is similar, but actually it depicts two hands and some rocks 石 on oracle bones; a conservative variant is 𠭊.
entries.皷: A variant of 鼓//, apparently contaminated by 皮.
entries.皿: Pictogram – A pictograph of an empty container, such as a chalice. The handles are conjoined in the modern form.
entries.盂: Phono-semantic compound: 于 (phonetic) + 皿 (dish; vessel, semantic)
entries.盅: Phono-semantic compound: 中 (phonetic) + 皿 (dish; vessel, semantic).
entries.盈: Uncertain. Compound ideogram: 夃 + 皿 (vessel). Meaning of the 夃 component is unclear.
entries.益:
Compound ideogram: 水 (water) + 皿 (vessel). Original form of 溢. Upper component resembles 氺 in a horizontal form.

Compare 易.
entries.盍: Original form of 蓋., a container and its lid.
entries.盎: Phono-semantic compound: 央 (phonetic) + 皿 (dish; vessel, semantic)
entries.监: Simplified from 監.; compare 览.
entries.盖: Found in the Zhengzitong 《正字通》 as an unorthodox variant (俗字) of 蓋. Currently used as the form adopted in mainland China.
entries.盜:
In oracle bone script, Phono-semantic compound: 㳄 (phonetic) + 舟 (boat) – an overflowing river. This character is technically a different word than the modern 盜, used interchangeably with 衍 in oracle bones, or as a phonetic loan for 羨, and 延 in bronze script. The component 舟 corrupted into 皿 in Chu script.

盜 on the other hand, is a Compound ideogram: 㳄 (drooling; craving) + 皿 (vessel) – to covet someone else's possessions → to steal.
entries.盞: Phono-semantic compound: 戔 (phonetic) + 皿 (vessel, semantic).
entries.盟:
Oracle bone script (𥁰): Phono-semantic compound: 囧 (semantic) + 皿 (phonetic).

Bronze inscriptions (𥂗): Phono-semantic compound: 朙 (phonetic) + 皿 (semantic). 月 was added to 𥁰. 朙 is an ancient form of 明, and now this character (盟) is a Phono-semantic compound: 明 (phonetic) + 皿 (semantic).
entries.盠: Phono-semantic compound: 彖 (phonetic) + 皿 (vessel, semantic).
entries.盡: Compound ideogram: 聿 (hand holding a brush) + 灬 (bristles) + 皿 (dish) – cleaning a dish with a brush – empty.
entries.監:
Compound ideogram: 臥 (a person with an emphasized eye) + 皿 (container): a person looking into a container. Original form of 鑑. 

The container later corrupted into 血; in the regular script, this additional stroke has migrated to below the 人 → ⿱𠂉丶/⿱𠂉一.
entries.盤:
Phono-semantic compound: 般 (phonetic) + 皿 (semantic).

凡 originally referred to this word, 殳 and 皿 were added later. The 凡 has also corrupted into 舟.
entries.盥: Compound ideogram: 𦥑 (pair of hands) + 水 (water) + 皿 (vessel) – hands holding water from a vessel.
entries.盧: Originally a Pictogram – an oven. 虍 and 皿 were added in the Chinese bronze inscriptions, and the oven pictogram came to be written 田, making the current form a Phono-semantic compound: 虍 (phonetic) + 田 (pictogram of an oven, semantic) + 皿 (vessel, semantic). This sense (“oven”) is now represented by the character 爐.
entries.盨: Phono-semantic compound: 須 (phonetic) + 皿 (vessel, semantic).
entries.目:
Pictogram – human eye, now rotated 90 degrees. Compare the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓁹.

See also 直, 見, 頁, 夏, 面, 臣 and the earlier versions of 要. The eye is not rotated in the character 𢛳, 曼, 睪, and 眔 (used in 褱).

Sometimes it depicts a web (网) through its variant 罒, e.g., 買, 罵, 罪, 詈 (used in 罰) and 羅 (> 罗). Unrelated to 鼎, 貝, and 真.
entries.盯: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 丁 (phonetic).
entries.盲: Phono-semantic compound: 亡 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic).
entries.直:
Oracle bone script: Compound ideogram: 目 (eye) + 丨 (?). 

Used in oracle bone inscriptions as a sacrificial verb, the original character of 徝 or 循 ("to patrol; to follow"), and to denote compliance. 

Later forms containing 𠃊(直) are actually the original character of 置. Unrelated to 具 and 真.
entries.盹: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 屯 (phonetic)
entries.盾: Pictogram – a shield (in the oracle bone script). Note that under the 𠂆 is not 直 - one less stroke here. See also 古, perhaps a differentiation of 盾.
entries.省: Originally 眚. In oracle bone script, an Phono-semantic compound: 生 (phonetic) + 目 (eye) – "to inspect". In Shuowen Jiezi, 眚 and 省 became separate characters. 生 corrupted over time into 少.
entries.眈: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 冘 (phonetic).
entries.眉: Pictogram: 𠃜 + 目, hair above an eye. The component for hair became 𠃜 during the development into the seal and clerical scripts.
entries.看: Compound ideogram: 手 (hand) + 目 (eye) – to put a hand above eyes to gaze afar.
entries.眔: Pictogram: an eye (目) with teardrops (now written similar to 水*).
entries.眚: Phono-semantic compound: 生 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic).
entries.眝: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 宁 (phonetic)
entries.真:
Bronze inscriptions: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (cowrie; shell, semantic) + 𠂈 (phonetic). 𠂈 is the original pictograph of 顛 (“to fall headlong”). From the late Western Zhou period, forms with 鼎 instead of 貝 are also attested.

Oracle-bone forms are composed of 匕 (“spoon”) and 鼎. These have been read by some scholars as 真, but some of them are better interpreted as 肆 or 煮.

In Chu bamboo-slip script, forms with 鼎 became dominant. The legs of 鼎 gradually became graphically confused with 火, and the lower horizontal stroke, left-falling stroke, and dot in Qin-slip and later forms of 真 may be reduced from 火. In the Zeng Hou Yi bamboo slips, an elaborated form with an added 丌 at the bottom is also attested.
entries.眠: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 民 (phonetic) – close your eyes and go to sleep.
entries.眩: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 玄 (phonetic).
entries.眭: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 圭 (phonetic).
entries.眳: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 名 (phonetic).
entries.眵: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 多 (phonetic).
entries.眷: Phono-semantic compound: 龹 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic).
entries.眺: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.眼: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 艮 (phonetic).
entries.眾:
Pictogram: a sun (日) above three humans (㐺) – people gathered or working under the sun.

The top, originally 日 in oracle script has been modified, in bronze script resembling instead a horizontal eye (early form of 目) – reinterpreted as “a crowd under someone’s gaze”, and now resembles 罒.

The bottom, originally three figures (人人人), uses various forms of 人 and 亻, with variation depending on font.
entries.着:
Corrupted variant of 著 (艹 → 䒑; 日 → 目). Recorded as an unorthodox form (俗字*) in the Tang dynasty orthographic dictionary Ganlu Zishu 干祿字書. 

Later dictionaries such as the Ming dynasty 《字學三正》 and Qing dynasty Zhengzitong 正字通 recorded the glyph as ⿱𦍌⿰丿目.
entries.睎: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 希 (phonetic)
entries.睏: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 困 (phonetic).
entries.睔: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 侖 (phonetic).
entries.睘: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 袁 (phonetic); 袁 is often abbreviated.
entries.睚: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 厓 (phonetic).
entries.睞: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 來 (phonetic).
entries.睡: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 垂 (phonetic) – sleep.
entries.督: Phono-semantic compound: 叔 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic) – to look over, to oversee (with eyes).
entries.睦: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eyes, semantic) + 坴 (phonetic).
entries.睫: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 疌 (phonetic)
entries.睬: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 采 (phonetic).
entries.睴: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).
entries.睽: Phono-semantic compound: 䀠 (two eyes, semantic) + 癸 (phonetic). The 䀠 component later became a 目 component.
entries.睿: Simplified from 叡, see there for more.
entries.瞀: Phono-semantic compound: 敄 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic)
entries.瞄: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 苗 (phonetic)
entries.瞅: Considered a 後起字. Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 秋 (phonetic).
entries.瞈: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 翁 (phonetic).
entries.瞌: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 盍 (phonetic).
entries.瞍: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 叟 (phonetic)。
entries.瞑: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 冥 (dark, phonetic) – to close one's eyes.
entries.瞓: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 訓 (phonetic).
entries.瞞: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 㒼 (to cover something carefully and tightly without a break, phonetic).
entries.瞥: Phono-semantic compound: 敝 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic).
entries.瞧: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 焦 (phonetic).
entries.瞪: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 登 (phonetic).
entries.瞬: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 舜 (phonetic).
entries.瞭: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.瞵: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eyes, semantic) + 粦 (phonetic)
entries.瞻: Phono-semantic compound: 目 (eye, semantic) + 詹 (phonetic)
entries.瞿: Phono-semantic compound: 䀠 (eyes, phonetic) + 隹 (bird, semantic).
entries.矍: Phono-semantic compound – and Compound ideogram: phonetic and semantic 瞿 + 又 (a hand catching a bird 隹).
entries.矕: Phono-semantic compound: 䜌 (phonetic) + 目 (eye, semantic).
entries.矛: The pictogram of a bamboo spear with a ring in the middle. Unrelated to 予.
entries.矢: Pictogram – an arrow. More recognizable in older forms. Compare 畀 and 至. See also the bottom component of 睪 and the original versions of 弗 and 𢦏.
entries.矣: Phono-semantic compound: 以 (phonetic) + 矢 (arrow, semantic). 矢 may also act as a phonetic component.
entries.知: Originally the same character as 智, used interchangeably. In oracle bone inscriptions, Compound ideogram: 大 (adult) + 口 (mouth) + 子 (child) – to transmit knowledge. In the Warring States period, 大 corrupted into 矢 and became a sound component. In Han_dynasty#Western_Han script the component 子 started being dropped, arriving at the modern form.
entries.矧: Phono-semantic compound: 矢 (arrow, semantic) + 引 (phonetic).
entries.矩:
Chen (2021): Pictogram: a man holding a carpenter's square. Original character for 矩. The man, originally 大 corrupted first into 夫 and then into 矢. In some versions, a semantic 木 can be seen.

Shuowen mistakenly interprets it as a compound; however, 巨 is a later simplification.
entries.矬: Phono-semantic compound: 矢 (arrow, semantic) + 坐 (phonetic).
entries.矯: Phono-semantic compound: 矢 (arrow, semantic) + 喬 (phonetic): to straighten; to make as straight as an arrow shaft.
entries.矰: Phono-semantic compound: 矢 (arrow, semantic) + 曾 (phonetic).
entries.石: Pictogram: representation of a qing (磬). 口 was subsequently added as a decorative element. Compare 叚 and 段.
entries.矸: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 干 (phonetic)
entries.矼: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 工 (phonetic)
entries.矽: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 夕 (phonetic).
entries.矾: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 凡 (phonetic).
entries.砂: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 沙 (phonetic). Originally, this character was a variant form of 沙, a Pictogram – that represents the appearance of sand along a riverbank.
entries.砌: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 切 (phonetic).
entries.砍: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 欠 (phonetic).
entries.砒: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 比 (phonetic).
entries.砥: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 氐 (phonetic).
entries.砱: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 令 (phonetic).
entries.砲: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 包 (phonetic). It originally referred to the catapult that launches stones far away, and by extension, it came to mean "cannon."
entries.砿:
Simplified from 礦. in Japanese shinjitai.

In current form, 石 (stone) + 広.
entries.硌: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.硒: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 西 (phonetic).
entries.硝: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 肖 (phonetic)
entries.硞: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone; rock, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.硩: Phono-semantic compound: 折 (phonetic) + 石 (rock; stone, semantic).
entries.硫: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 流 (phonetic).
entries.硭: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 芒 (phonetic).
entries.硼: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 朋 (phonetic).
entries.碁: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 其 (phonetic).
entries.碇: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock; stone, semantic) + 定 (phonetic).
entries.碌: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 彔 (phonetic).
entries.碍: Compound ideogram: 石 (rock) + 得 (obtain, find) — a rock obstructing one from getting what one wants. Note that 㝵 is the ancient form of 得, so a direct derivation from 石 + 㝵 may be possible as well, although not supported by Kanjigen.
entries.碎: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 卒 (phonetic).
entries.碏: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 昔 (phonetic)
entries.碑: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 卑 (phonetic).
entries.碗: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 宛 (phonetic).
entries.碙: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 岡 (phonetic).
entries.碧: Phono-semantic compound: 玉 (jade, semantic) + 石 (stone, semantic) + 白 (phonetic).
entries.碰: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 並 (phonetic).
entries.碲: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 帝 (phonetic).
entries.確: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 隺 (phonetic) – rock-solid, as certain as a rock.
entries.碼: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone; rock, semantic) + 馬 (phonetic).
entries.碾: Alternative form of 輾, using 石 as semantic part instead of 車.
entries.磁: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock; stone, semantic) + 兹 (phonetic).
entries.磂: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 留 (phonetic).
entries.磅: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock; stone, semantic) + 旁 (phonetic).
entries.磋: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 差 (phonetic).
entries.磐: Phono-semantic compound: 般 (phonetic) + 石 (stone, semantic).
entries.磒: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 員 (phonetic).
entries.磕: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 盍 (phonetic).
entries.磚: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 專 (phonetic).
entries.磨: Originally written as 䃺. Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 靡 (phonetic).
entries.磬: Compound ideogram: 殸 + 石 (stone). See 殸 for more.
entries.磯: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 幾 (phonetic).
entries.磷: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 粦 (phonetic).
entries.磺: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock; stone, semantic) + 黃 (phonetic).
entries.磽: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic).
entries.礁: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (rock, semantic) + 焦 (phonetic).
entries.礄: Considered a 後起字. Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 喬 (phonetic).
entries.礎: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 楚 (phonetic) – a kind of stone, a plinth.
entries.礜: Phono-semantic compound: 與 (phonetic) + 石 (stone; rock, semantic)
entries.礦: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 廣 (phonetic).
entries.礩: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone; rock, semantic) + 質 (phonetic).
entries.礫: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 樂 (phonetic)
entries.礬: Phono-semantic compound: 樊 (phonetic) + 石 (stone, semantic).
entries.礵: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 霜 (phonetic).
entries.礹: Phono-semantic compound: 石 (stone, semantic) + 嚴 (phonetic).
entries.示: Pictogram – an altar. The original form is similar to unrelated character 丅, and additional strokes are added to prevent confusion with an ancient variant of 下 and the ancient version of 主. See also 帝. Unrelated to 小 and the bottom part of 京.
entries.礼: Based on an ancient form of 禮* recorded in Shuowen as. In regular script, the earliest record can be traced back to the Tang dynasty orthographical dictionary Ganlu Zishu 干祿字書.
entries.社: Compound ideogram: 示 (god; deity) + 土 (soil)
entries.祀: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (divinity, semantic) + 巳 (phonetic)
entries.祁: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (phonetic) + 邑 (place, semantic).
entries.祆: Compound ideogram: 示 (semantic) + 天 (heaven, phonetic).
entries.祈: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 斤 (phonetic).
entries.祉: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 止 (phonetic).
entries.祐: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (spirit, semantic) + 右 (phonetic).
entries.祕: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 必 (phonetic) – arcane, secret rituals.
entries.祖: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (semantic) + 且 (phonetic). Specialization of 且. See there for more.
entries.祜: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (divine, semantic) + 古 (phonetic).
entries.祝: Ideogram – a man kneeling with open mouth (兄) next to an altar (示).
entries.神:
Phono-semantic compound: 示 (god; deity, semantic) + 申 (lightning, phonetic).

Originally 申 in the oracle bone script and in some bronze inscriptions. The ancients feared the unpredictable lightning and considered it to be divine or of divine origin. 示 was added for specialization.
entries.祟:
In oracle bone script Compound ideogram: 木 (wood) + 示 (altar) – burning of wood to consult the gods. Originally the same character as 奈

In the modern form 木 has corrupted into 出, thus the character can be interpreted as Phono-semantic compound: 出 (phonetic) + 示 (altar, semantic).
entries.祠: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (divinity, semantic) + 司 (phonetic).
entries.祥: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 羊 (phonetic). Originally just 羊, 示 was added later to distinguish it.
entries.票:
Simplified from 𤐫. Compound ideogram: 火 (fire, semantic) + 𢍱 (to rise high, semantic), which represents two pairs of hands holding and rising an object, perhaps a bag or basket (西). The character originally represented the idea of sparks rising up. By extension, it was also used to mean "token" or "label." Then, the two pair of hands disappeared in the modern version.

Unrelated to the original version of 要 and 栗.
entries.祭:
Compound ideogram: 肉 (meat) + 又 (hand) + 示 (altar, ceremony) – the hand offers a piece of meat at the altar during a ceremony.

The 肉 is turned on its side and appears as 𱼀 in the regular script (compare 將, 然). The top right part is a form of 又.

The top is not related to but may be corrupted to 癶 in calligraphy and handwriting; this form also appeared in the second-round simplified list.
entries.祿: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (spirit, semantic) + 彔 (phonetic).
entries.禁: Phono-semantic compound: 林 (phonetic) + 示 (altar, semantic).
entries.禅:
Simplified from 禪.

Simplified from 禪. (2 strokes on top of phonetic) in simplified Chinese.

Simplified from 禪. (3 strokes on top of phonetic) in Japanese shinjitai.
entries.禍: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (sacrifice, semantic) + 咼 (phonetic).
entries.禓: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (sacrifice, semantic) + 昜 (phonetic).
entries.禡: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 馬 (phonetic).
entries.禮:
Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 豊 (ceremony, phonetic) – performing rites at the altar.

Originally written 豊, see there for more.
entries.禱: Phono-semantic compound: 示 (altar, semantic) + 壽 (phonetic).
entries.禸:
According to Xu Shen, it is the pictogram of a print of an animal paw. If so, then it is unrelated to the bottom part of 禹, 离, 禽, and 禺 and also unrelated to 虫, in which it represents the tail of a snake, and 萬, in which it represents the tail of a scorpion.

However, Liu Zhao claims that it is related to some of these, having evolved from the bottom parts of 萬, 禽, and 禹 despite its different origins in these characters.
entries.禹: The Shuowen interprets the character as Pictogram – of an animal. The bronze-script character clearly shows the 虫 component.
entries.禺:
Unclear. Shuowen considers it to be an Compound ideogram: 甶 (head of a ghost) + 禸 (to trample) – a kind of monkey.

In the bronze script, the top of the character resembles the head of a ghost (鬼) and/or a mask (異) and the bottom resembles 禹. considers this character differentiated (分化) from 禹 and that the character is a Pictogram – of a kind of insect with a decorative mark, similar to the one in 萬.
entries.离:
In bronze inscriptions, Compound ideogram: 林 (forest) + 𠦒 (net) – to set up a net in the forest for hunting. 

The modern form descends from a variant that replaced 林 with 艸, later simplified as 屮 in small seal script, which corrupted further into 亠 in clerical script. The bottom component 𠦒 has corrupted into ⿱凶禸. Compare with 畢 and 禽.

Exists as traditional character, but also Simplified from 離.
entries.禼: Pictogram – of an insect. Possibly a variant of 萬.
entries.禾: Pictogram – picture of a plant stalk. The stalk is more recognizable in older form. Similar to 來 but unrelated to 釆. It later derived the glyph of 株 and 硃
entries.禿: Compound ideogram: 毛 (hair) + 儿 (person). 毛 later corrupted into 禾.
entries.秀:
From an earlier form 𥝙, attested in the stone drum inscriptions (石鼓文) from the Warring States period.

According to, the character is an Compound ideogram: 禾 (rice plant) + 引 (to draw out flowers) — blooming of a rice plant. The Shuihudi Qin bamboo texts (睡虎地秦簡) recorded this character as ⿱禾引. The bottom component 弓* found in the stone drum inscriptions is likely a reduction of 引*.

Xu Kai (徐鍇), the author of 說文解字繫傳 (10th century AD) gave the following explanation: Pictogram: 禾 (plant) + 乃, resembling a fruit/an ear hanging off a plant.

Shuowen states that this character was tabooed at that time (2nd century AD) and so did not elaborate on its origin, due to it being the birth name of Emperor Guangwu of Han.
entries.私: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (semantic) + 厶 (private, phonetic). 厶 originally referred to this word, 禾 was added later.
entries.秉: Compound ideogram: 禾 (plant) + 又 (hand) — a hand holding a plant by the stalk. Compare: 兼, a hand holding two plants.
entries.秋: The oracle bone forms and bronze inscriptions show the Pictogram – of a cricket or a locust, sometimes with a fire 火 glyph underneath. In its later form, became a Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 𤒅 (phonetic). Often thought of as an Compound ideogram: 禾 (grain) + 火 (fire); after harvesting the grain, the fields are burned to kill locusts and their eggs.
entries.种: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (rice, semantic) + 中 (phonetic).
entries.科: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (phonetic) + 斗 (measuring tool, semantic).
entries.秒: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (cereal; grain, semantic) + 少 (phonetic).
entries.秘:
In current form: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (semantic) + 必 (phonetic).

Variant (俗字) of 祕 via 示 → 禾, hence there is a reference to secret rituals and the concept of arcane.
entries.租:
Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (semantic) + 且 (phonetic).

Land rent was paid in grain.
entries.秦:
In the oracle bone script, an Compound ideogram: 午 (“pestle”, the original form of 杵) + 廾 + two 禾. The most conservative variant is 𥢮. A form of its bronze inscription containing only one 禾 developed into the subsequent small seal script form in Shuowen. The 午 and 廾 components have fused into 𡗗 in the modern form.

According to Shuowen Jiezi, the glyph is an Compound ideogram: 舂 (to pound grain) + 禾 (grain) – husked grain. However this would necessitate a phonological shift that is considered unlikely, and furthermore is likely a folk etymology altogether.
entries.秧: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain; cereal, semantic) + 央 (phonetic).
entries.秩: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 失 (phonetic). It originally referred to rice plants being piled up in order, and by extension, conveys the idea of "sequence" or "order."
entries.秫: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 朮 (glutinous millet, phonetic). Originally written 朮 (not to be confused with 术).
entries.称:
Simplified from 穪., where 穪 is corrupted from 稱. It was found in various Movable type#Metal movable type in China copies of Classic Chinese Novels. First attested in 《宋元以來俗字譜》, a Variant Chinese character dictionary compiled in 1930 that records unorthodox forms (俗字) that have existed since the Song dynasty.

Adopted as an official simplified character by the People's Republic of China in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme.
entries.秲: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic)
entries.稀: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 希 (rare; sparse, phonetic).
entries.稃: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 孚 (phonetic).
entries.稈: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (cereal, semantic) + 旱 (phonetic).
entries.程: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 呈 (phonetic) – measurements.
entries.税: Simplified from 稅. Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (semantic) + 兑 (phonetic).
entries.稑: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (cereal, semantic) + 坴 (phonetic)
entries.稔: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 念 (phonetic).
entries.稚:
Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (rice, semantic) + 屖 (phonetic).

During the Han Dynasty, the 屖 component was commonly substituted with 隹.
entries.稞: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (rice, semantic) + 果 (phonetic).
entries.稟: Compound ideogram: 㐭 (granary) + 禾 (grain) meaning "to gift grain".
entries.稧: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 契 (phonetic).
entries.稱: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (rice, semantic) + 爯 (phonetic) – measure rice.
entries.稲:
Variant of 稻. The component 旧 is a variant of 臼.

The Japanese usage is of reform (shinjitai) nature.
entries.稺: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (rice, semantic) + 屖 (phonetic).
entries.稻: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, cereal, rice, semantic) + 舀 (phonetic).
entries.稽:
Originally 𩒨, a Phono-semantic compound: 旨 (phonetic) + 頁 (person's head, semantic).

In the modern form it is a Phono-semantic compound: 𥝌 (bent, stunted tree, semantic) + 尤 (semantic) + 旨 (phonetic).
entries.穁: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 茸 (phonetic)
entries.穂: Found in the historical Longkan Shoujian 《龍龕手鑑》 dictionary compiled in 997 AD.
entries.穆: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 㣎 (phonetic) – standing grain.
entries.穎: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 頃 (phonetic).
entries.穗: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 惠 (phonetic).
entries.穜: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 童 (phonetic).
entries.穡: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (cereal; grain, semantic) + 嗇 (phonetic). Specialization of 嗇.
entries.穢: Phono-semantic compound: 禾 (grain, semantic) + 歲 (phonetic).
entries.穴: Pictogram – possibly an entrance to a cave or a door flap. A conservative version is 𠕉. See also 奐 and the top component of 罙.
entries.究: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 九 (phonetic).
entries.空: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, hole, semantic) + 工 (phonetic).
entries.穿: Compound ideogram: 穴 (cave) + 牙 (tooth) – to penetrate through, to pass through.
entries.突: Shuowen: Compound ideogram: 穴 (cave; den) + 犬 (dog) – a dog suddenly coming out of a den.
entries.窄: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave; hole, semantic) + 乍 (phonetic)
entries.窈: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 幼 (phonetic).
entries.窕: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.窖: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (hole; cave, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.窟: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (hole; cave, semantic) + 屈 (phonetic).
entries.窩: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 咼 (phonetic).
entries.窪: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (hole, semantic) + 洼 (puddle, pool, to sink, phonetic).
entries.窮: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave; nest; confinement, semantic) + 躬 (phonetic).
entries.窯: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave; hole, semantic) + 羔 (phonetic). It represents a hole used for firing pottery, which is a pottery kiln.
entries.窶: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, hole, semantic) + 婁 (phonetic).
entries.竂: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.竃: Japanese shinjitai character. Simplified from 竈.
entries.竄: Compound ideogram: 鼠 (mouse) + 穴 (hole) – to hide in a hole.
entries.竅: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 敫 (phonetic).
entries.竊:
In the Warring States period, the character existed in the forms 𢿑 and 𱡡; the latter of which is likely the ancestor of the modern form, a Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice) + 攴 (action) + 禼 (phonetic) – theft.

 

In the western Han the component 宀 was added to emphasize the meaning of theft. The component 禼 would often be written as 萬 due to their graphic and phonetic similarity.

 

In eastern Han seal script, 宀 had corrupted into 穴. This form also included a 廿 subcomponent, which is likely a corruption of the upper part of 萬, while the lower part corrupted back into the original phonetic component 禼. Shuowen regards 廿 as the phonetic component, although that is not etymologically accurate. 

In the modern form, 米 has corrupted into 釆, and the 廿 from seal script is omitted.
entries.立: Pictogram – a person standing on the ground; compare 大 and 文.
entries.站: Phono-semantic compound: 立 (semantic) + 占 (phonetic). A relatively late character – not found in Shuowen; found in Guangyun.
entries.竜: Recorded as an ancient form of 龍* in the Kangxi dictionary in 1716 AD. Earlier dictionaries such as Longkan Shoujian 龍龕手鑑 in 997 AD and Jiyun 集韻 in 1037 AD recorded the glyph as 𥪖*.
entries.竞: Simplified from 競., a duplication of this character.
entries.章: Compound ideogram: A chisel 辛 piercing a piece of untreated jade in the middle of the character (now 日). Originally meaning "to treat jade", likely the original character of 璋 or 彰.
entries.竢: Phono-semantic compound: 立 (to stand, semantic) + 矣 (phonetic).
entries.競: According to Shuowen, an Compound ideogram: 誩 (argument) + 儿 (man) + 儿 (man) – two individuals debating vigorously. Also possibly a Phono-semantic compound: 誩 (phonetic) + 儿 (man, semantic) + 儿 (man, semantic). Compare 友.
entries.竹:
Pictogram – two bamboo stalks, with leaves. Earlier forms resembled 个 + 个, current form resembles rather ケ + ケ, or 亇 + 亇.

See also the original version of 散.
entries.竺: Shuowen: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (phonetic) + 二 (semantic) ― thick.
entries.竿: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 干 (phonetic).
entries.笄: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 幵 (phonetic). See also the top component of 每.
entries.笆: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 巴 (phonetic).
entries.笈: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 及 (phonetic)
entries.笑:
Originally Phono-semantic compound: 艸 (grass, phonetic) + 犬 (dog, semantic).

Later, Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (semantic) + 夭 (phonetic).
entries.笔: Compound ideogram: 竹 (bamboo) + 毛 (hair) Traditional Chinese brushes were made of bamboo and hair.
entries.笙: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 生 (phonetic).
entries.笛: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 由 (phonetic).
entries.笠: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 立 (phonetic).
entries.笥: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 司 (phonetic).
entries.符: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 付 (phonetic).
entries.第:
Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 弟 (phonetic). 竹 here refers to the bamboo strips used for writing (e.g. accounting, classification) in ancient times. See also 等.

Alternatively, may have originally been written 弟.
entries.笱: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 句 (phonetic).
entries.笴: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 可 (phonetic).
entries.筆: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 聿 (writing brush, phonetic). 聿 originally referred to this word; 竹 was added later to differentiate.
entries.筈: According to Kanjigen, Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 舌 (phonetic), with 舌 in this case being a variant of 𠯑, a variation observed also in the alternative forms 栝/桰.
entries.等:
Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic).

竹 here refers to the bamboo strips used for writing (e.g. grading, classification) in ancient times. 寺 was originally used phonetically; the character was subsequently borrowed for another word with the same meaning, but with no phonetic resemblance to 寺.
entries.筊: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 交 (phonetic).
entries.筋: Compound ideogram: 竹 (bamboo) + 𠛧 (peel) – sinew (bamboo is sinewy when peeled). The component 力 is a corruption of 刀 (刂).
entries.筍: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 旬 (phonetic).
entries.筏: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 伐 (phonetic).
entries.筑:
Compound ideogram: 竹 (bamboo, phonetic) + 𢀜 (to hold).

Also Simplified from 築.
entries.筒: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 同 (phonetic)
entries.答: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 合 (phonetic). Originally, it was a variant of 荅, where the semantic component 艸 (grass) was later mistakenly replaced by 竹 (bamboo). It expresses the meaning of "to respond."
entries.筕: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 行 (phonetic).
entries.策:
Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 朿 (phonetic).;"to whip"

Originally 敇.
entries.筠: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 均 (phonetic).
entries.筧: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 見 (phonetic).
entries.筮: Compound ideogram: 竹 (bamboo) + 巫 (shaman) + 𠬞 (two hands) – to divine using yarrow stalks or some kind of tools made of bamboo.
entries.筱: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 攸 (phonetic).
entries.筵: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 延 (phonetic).
entries.筶: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.筸: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 旱 (phonetic).
entries.箇: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 固 (phonetic) — a stalk of bamboo.
entries.箋: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 戔 (phonetic). It expresses the idea of a small bamboo strip, and by extension, signifies a “tag” or “label.”
entries.箍: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 㧜 (phonetic)
entries.箏: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 爭 (phonetic).
entries.箓: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 彔 (phonetic)
entries.箔: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 泊 (thin, phonetic).
entries.箕: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 其 (phonetic). Specialization of 其.
entries.算:
In current form, 竹 (bamboo) + 目 + 廾.

The 目 portion may have originally represented counting rods (or possibly an abacus, although the character is believed to predate its invention). Such rods were typically made from bamboo. Perhaps related to the top component of 學, hence to 爻.

Similar but unrelated to 具.
entries.箙:
Originally a Pictogram – one or two arrows in a quiver.

In the Chinese bronze inscriptions, the arrowhead merged with the quiver into 用, giving rise to the form now written 𤰈 and inherited in the character 備.

The modern form 箙 is a Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 服 (phonetic).
entries.箝: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 拑 (phonetic)
entries.箠: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 垂 (phonetic).
entries.管: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 官 (phonetic).
entries.箭: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 前 (phonetic).
entries.箱: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 相 (phonetic) – a bamboo box.
entries.箴: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 咸 (phonetic) – a bamboo needle, probe.
entries.箸: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 者 (phonetic).
entries.節: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 即 (phonetic). It represents the "node" of bamboo, and by extension, signifies a segment or boundary.
entries.篂: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 星 (phonetic).
entries.範: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 笵 (phonetic).
entries.築: Phono-semantic compound: 筑 (phonetic) + 木 (wood, semantic).
entries.篋: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 匧 (phonetic).
entries.篙: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 高 (phonetic).
entries.篝: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 冓 (phonetic).
entries.篞: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 涅 (phonetic).
entries.篠: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 條 (phonetic).
entries.篣: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 旁 (phonetic)
entries.篤: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (phonetic) + 馬 (horse, semantic).
entries.篴: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 逐 (phonetic).
entries.篷: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 逢 (phonetic).
entries.篸: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 參 (phonetic).
entries.篾: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 蔑 (phonetic).
entries.篿: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 專 (phonetic)
entries.簃: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 移 (phonetic)
entries.簇: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 族 (phonetic)
entries.簌: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 欶 (phonetic).
entries.簍: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 婁 (phonetic).
entries.簏: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 鹿 (phonetic)
entries.簓: Kokuji (created in Japan). Compound ideogram: 竹 (bamboo) + 彫 (carve; engrave; chisel).
entries.簝: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.簞: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 單 (phonetic).
entries.簢: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 閔 (phonetic).
entries.簣: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 貴 (phonetic).
entries.簫: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 肅 (phonetic).
entries.簳: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 幹 (phonetic).
entries.簽: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 僉 (phonetic).
entries.簿: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 溥 (phonetic).
entries.籃: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 監 (phonetic).
entries.籊: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 翟 (phonetic).
entries.籌: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 壽 (phonetic).
entries.籍: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 耤 (phonetic) – the (bamboo) census books.
entries.籐: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 滕 (phonetic).
entries.籜: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 擇 (phonetic).
entries.籤: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 韱 (phonetic).
entries.籥: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 龠 (phonetic).
entries.籩: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 邊 (phonetic).
entries.籬: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 離 (phonetic)
entries.籮: Phono-semantic compound: 竹 (bamboo, semantic) + 羅 (phonetic).
entries.籲: Phono-semantic compound: 籥 (phonetic) + 頁 (head, semantic).
entries.米:
Pictogram – rice kernels without husk. The character 粟, by contrast, refers to rice kernels with husk. According to Li Xiaoding (李孝定), the horizontal stroke is a bamboo sieve (籭 or 篩子). See also the bottom component of 暴 in its original form.

Unrelated to 木, 禾, and 来.
entries.籽: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice; grain, semantic) + 子 (phonetic).
entries.籾: Kokuji (created in Japan)., an Compound ideogram: 米 (rice) + 刃 (blade), from the way the hull of rice tapers into a sharp tip.
entries.粁: Compound ideogram: 米 (meter) + 千 (one thousand)
entries.粉: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 分 (phonetic) – face powder made of rice.
entries.粍: Kokuji (created in Japan). Compound ideogram: 米 (metre) + 毛 (one thousandth).
entries.粎: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (metre, phonetic) + 尺 (measure, semantic).
entries.粒: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 立 (phonetic).
entries.粗: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 且 (phonetic).
entries.粘: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 占 (phonetic) – glutinous, sticky rice.
entries.粙: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 由 (phonetic).
entries.粟:
Pictogram – in oracle bone script. During the Warring States period, Phono-semantic compound: 角 (phonetic) + 米 (rice, semantic). 角 corrupted into 𠧪, thus getting the intermediate form 𥻆. Eventually, it was further corrupted into 西.

In ancient times, this character was used to indicate rice kernels with husk, while 米 was used to indicate rice without husk.
entries.粢: Phono-semantic compound: 次 (phonetic) + 米 (grain, semantic).
entries.粥: The reduced form of the character 鬻, which was an ideogrammic compound and the original character for "congee".
entries.粦: First attested as the phonetic component of 憐 in stone carvings in a form ancestral to the small seal script. In the small seal script, 舛 is graphically detached from the 大 with the dots, which in turn is split vertically and interpreted as the unrelated 炎; Shuowen erroneously interprets it as an Compound ideogram: 炎 (fire; flame) + 舛 (feet). In the regular script, the top further corrupts into the unrelated 米.
entries.粧:
Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 庄 (phonetic). It conveys the meaning of "face powder" and, by extension, is used to mean "to adorn oneself."

Originally, it was a popular variant of the character 妝.
entries.粪: Simplified from 糞. First appears in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme.
entries.粮: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (food, semantic) + 良 (phonetic); also Simplified from 糧.
entries.粵:
A specialization of 雩 by modification of 雨.

Shuowen interprets it as an Compound ideogram: 宷 + 亏.
entries.粽: Phono-semantic compound: 米 (rice, semantic) + 宗 (phonetic).
