entries.蝒: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 面 (phonetic).
entries.蝘: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 匽 (phonetic).
entries.蝜: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 負 (phonetic).
entries.蝠: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (semantic) + 畐 (phonetic). An extinct Pictogram – of a bat occurs in the oracle bone and bronze scripts; it is thought to write this word but is not ancestral to the character 蝠.
entries.蝥: Phono-semantic compound: 敄 (phonetic) + 虫 (insect, semantic)
entries.蝦: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 叚 (phonetic).
entries.蝴: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 胡 (phonetic).
entries.蝶: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 枼 (phonetic).
entries.螉: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 翁 (phonetic).
entries.融: Phono-semantic compound: 鬲 (cauldron, semantic) + 蟲 (phonetic).
entries.螓: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 秦 (phonetic)
entries.螔: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 虒 (phonetic).
entries.螚: Phono-semantic compound: 能 (phonetic) + 虫 (insect, semantic).
entries.螞: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 馬 (phonetic).
entries.螫: Phono-semantic compound: 赦 (phonetic) + 虫 (bug, semantic).
entries.螭: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (creature, semantic) + 离 (phonetic).
entries.螯: Phono-semantic compound: 敖 (phonetic) + 虫 (insect, semantic) – part of an insect, its pincers.
entries.螲:
Simplified from 窒.

Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (semantic) + 窒 (phonetic).
entries.螾: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect; worm, semantic) + 寅 (phonetic).
entries.蟀: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 率 (phonetic).
entries.蟂: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect; creature, semantic) + 梟 (phonetic).
entries.蟄: Phono-semantic compound: 執 (phonetic) + 虫 (bug, semantic).
entries.蟍: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 梨 (phonetic)
entries.蟙: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (bug; creature, semantic) + 戠 (phonetic).
entries.蟧: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 勞 (phonetic).
entries.蟬: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 單 (phonetic).
entries.蟮: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect; worm, semantic) + 善 (phonetic).
entries.蟯: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic).
entries.蟱: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect; worm, semantic) + 無 (phonetic).
entries.蟲:
Compound ideogram: 虫 (snake; insect).

Note that 虫 is also a traditional character on its own.
entries.蟳: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (bug, semantic) + 尋 (phonetic).
entries.蟹: Phono-semantic compound: 解 (phonetic) + 虫 (semantic). Originally written as 蠏.
entries.蟻: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 義 (phonetic).
entries.蠅: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 黽 (phonetic).
entries.蠆: Phono-semantic compound: 萬 (phonetic) + 虫 (creature, semantic). This character represents the original meaning of 萬.
entries.蠉: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 睘 (phonetic)
entries.蠋: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 蜀 (phonetic)
entries.蠐: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 齊 (phonetic)
entries.蠓: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 蒙 (phonetic)
entries.蠙: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (worm, semantic) + 賓 (phonetic)
entries.蠚: Phono-semantic compound: 若 (phonetic) + 虫 (insect, semantic).
entries.蠟: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 巤 (phonetic).
entries.蠠: Phono-semantic compound: 面 (phonetic) + 䖵 (insects, semantic).
entries.蠢: Phono-semantic compound: 春 (phonetic) + 䖵 (insects, semantic).
entries.蠣: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect; bug; creature, semantic) + 厲 (phonetic).
entries.蠭: Phono-semantic compound: 逢 (phonetic) + 䖵 (insect, semantic). Original form of 蜂.
entries.蠮: Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 翳 (phonetic).
entries.蠱: Compound ideogram: 蟲 (insects) + 皿 (container) – poisonous insects raised in a container.
entries.蠹: Phono-semantic compound: 橐 (phonetic) + 䖵 (insect, semantic)
entries.蠻: Phono-semantic compound: 䜌 (phonetic) + 虫 (snake, semantic).
entries.蠼:
Simplified from 籰.

Phono-semantic compound: 虫 (insect, semantic) + 矍 (phonetic).
entries.衁: Phono-semantic compound: 亡 (phonetic) + 血 (blood, semantic).
entries.衄: Phono-semantic compound: 血 (blood, semantic) + 丑 (phonetic).
entries.衆: Variant of 眾, with the top component 罒 replaced by 血, and the bottom component 𫡑 replaced by 乑.
entries.衈: Phono-semantic compound: 血 (blood, semantic) + 耳 (ear, phonetic).
entries.衊: Phono-semantic compound: 血 (blood, semantic) + 蔑 (phonetic)
entries.衋: Phono-semantic compound: 聿 (semantic) + 皕 (phonetic) + 血 (blood, semantic).
entries.衍: Compound ideogram: 行 (path; way; to go; to move) + 水 (water).
entries.街:
Phono-semantic compound: 行 (semantic) + 圭 (phonetic).

Originally, the phonetic component is not related to the concept of earth (土) since in its original form it represents a pair of ritual axes perhaps made of jade 士. Hence, the link to the concept of earth in this character and 厓 either comes from folk etymology or its appearance in the Small Seal script.
entries.衚:
Simplified from 胡.

Phono-semantic compound: 行 (semantic) + 胡 (phonetic).
entries.衞: Simplified from 䘙. Compound ideogram: 行 (semantic) + 韋 (phonetic) + 帀 (semantic).
entries.衡: Phono-semantic compound: 行 (phonetic) + 角 (horn, semantic) + 大 (big, semantic).
entries.衣:
Pictogram – Outline of the chest, upper clothing. Compare to the upper part of 文.

This pictogram 衣 can be split into two parts and hold another component (e.g., 裹, 衮, 褱, 襄, and 𧝑 as used in 㞡 > 展). See also the top component of 雜.
entries.补: Simplified from 補., with a simpler yet more apparent phonetic component. Officially adopted as the simplified form of 補 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (s:漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
entries.表:
Originally 𧘝, an Compound ideogram: 衣 (garment; clothing) + 毛 (hair; feather) — outer garment.

Officially adopted as the simplified form of 錶 (etymology 2) in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (s:漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
entries.衩: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 叉 (phonetic)
entries.衭: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 夫 (phonetic).
entries.衰: Pictogram – a piece of clothing made from palm fibers to be used as a raincoat (original form of 蓑).
entries.衷: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 中 (middle; center, phonetic).
entries.衺: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 牙 (phonetic).
entries.袁: In oracle bone script, Compound ideogram: 衣 (clothes) + 又 (hand) – "to put on clothes; to wear", representing the original form of 擐. Some variant forms added 〇 (the earliest form of 圓, now written 口) as a sound component. The component 又 has corrupted into 㞢 in seal script and 土 in clerical script.
entries.袋: Phono-semantic compound: 代 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic).
entries.袍: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 包 (phonetic).
entries.袒: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 旦 (phonetic). The original form is 但, a Phono-semantic compound: 人 (person, semantic) + 旦 (phonetic).
entries.袖: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 由 (phonetic).
entries.袞: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 公 (phonetic)
entries.被: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 皮 (phonetic).
entries.袱: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 伏 (phonetic)
entries.袴: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (cloth, semantic) + 夸 (phonetic) – a type of clothing.
entries.裁: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (semantic) + 𢦏 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component has a reference to a blade and an arrow, hence to the concept of cutting (e.g., fabric).
entries.裂:
Phono-semantic compound: 列 (to tear, phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic) — to cut and tear clothes.

The phonetic 列 depicts bones being cut up with a blade and arranged in a line.
entries.裊:
Phono-semantic compound: 鳥 (phonetic) + 衣 (semantic).

Originally written 褭, see there for more.
entries.裏: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 里 (phonetic).
entries.裔: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (cloth, semantic) + 吶 (phonetic).
entries.裕: Phono-semantic compound: 谷 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic). Folk etymology claims 谷 to represent space in the clothes.
entries.裖: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing; garment, semantic) + 辰 (phonetic).
entries.裘: Phono-semantic compound: 求 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic).
entries.裙: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 君 (phonetic).
entries.補: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 甫 (phonetic).
entries.裝: Phono-semantic compound: 壯 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic).
entries.裡:
Simplified from 裏.

Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 里 (phonetic), unorthodox form of 裏.
entries.裱: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 表 (phonetic)
entries.裳: Phono-semantic compound: 尚 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothing, semantic).
entries.裴: Phono-semantic compound: 非 (phonetic) + 衣 (clothing, semantic).
entries.裸: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 果 (phonetic) – lacking clothes, naked.
entries.裹: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 果 (phonetic).
entries.製: Compound ideogram: 制 (to cut out; to make, phonetic) + 衣 (clothes, semantic).
entries.裾: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 居 (phonetic).
entries.褂: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 卦 (phonetic).
entries.複: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 复 (to return, phonetic) – lined garment.
entries.褌: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).
entries.褐: The original character is 褐. Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 曷 (phonetic). It conveys the meaning "a garment made of coarse cloth," and by extension, "rough or shabby clothing." The modern Jōyō kanji is a simplified form.
entries.褒:
Simplified from 襃.

Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (semantic) + 保 (phonetic).
entries.褔: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 畐 (phonetic).
entries.褚: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 者 (phonetic).
entries.褣: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 容 (phonetic)
entries.褦: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 能 (phonetic).
entries.褪: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 退 (phonetic). Considered a 後起字.
entries.褫: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 虒 (phonetic).
entries.褲: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 庫 (phonetic). Originally written 袴 or 絝, see there for more.
entries.褸: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 婁 (phonetic).
entries.褻: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 埶 (phonetic).
entries.襀: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 責 (phonetic).
entries.襄: Phono-semantic compound: 𤕦 (phonetic) + 衣 (semantic). However, the original version on oracle bones resembles a man with raised hands while undressing; later, a hand and the radical of the cloth were added.
entries.襆: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 菐 (phonetic).
entries.襔: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 㒼 (phonetic).
entries.襖: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 奧 (phonetic).
entries.襗: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 睪 (phonetic)
entries.襟: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 禁 (phonetic). It refers to the seam of a garment, conveying the idea of a “collar.”
entries.襠: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 當 (phonetic).
entries.襢: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 亶 (phonetic).
entries.襤: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothes, semantic) + 監 (phonetic).
entries.襪: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 蔑 (phonetic).
entries.襮: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 暴 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component means "to expose (to the sun)", so it could add part of the meaning. A conservative version is 𧟊; later, the character was stylized into 襮.
entries.襲:
Phono-semantic compound: 龖 (phonetic) + 衣 (cloth, semantic).

The bronze inscription and Shuowen zhouwen forms were in the form of 𧟟. The Shuowen small seal script form and subsequent forms are in the form of 襲, as the phonetic component 龖 has been reduced to 龍.
entries.襻: Phono-semantic compound: 衣 (clothing, semantic) + 攀 (phonetic).
entries.襾: According to Xu Shen, it is 冂 overlapped with 凵 and a horizontal stroke on top to indicate the act of covering something.
entries.西:
The oracle-bone forms of 西 fall into two types: open-topped and closed-topped. The open-topped type is found only in periods I–II, especially in the Bin and Chu groups; later scripts inherit the closed-topped type.

The open-topped form has been interpreted as a bird's nest, possibly related to 栖 (“to perch; to roost”). The later closed-topped form may be related to 囟: in the Zhouyuan oracle-bone inscriptions, 囟 is used for 西.
entries.要:
Pictogram: a man 大 then drawn as a woman (女) with two hands pointing to his/her midsection. On top of the character there was huge eye 目, then stylized as a horn 角. The hands gradually shifted upwards; hence, a nearly original version of the character is 𡢗. All the upper part was eventually stylized as 覀. Unrelated to 栗 but partly related to 票.

Original meaning was “waist” (now 腰).
entries.覃: Appears as 𪉷 in the small seal script.
entries.見: Compound ideogram – - 目 (eye) + 卩 (kneeling person) – a kneeling human figure with a large eye for a head. Similar but unrelated to 艮. See also 夏 and 監.
entries.覓: Compound ideogram: 爪 (hand) + 見 (to see).
entries.覕: Phono-semantic compound: 必 (phonetic) + 見 (to see, semantic).
entries.視:
Phono-semantic compound: 示 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).

Related to 見. The Chu form did not include the phonetic 示 component, making it near-identical to 見, but with the lower component a kneeling figure rather than a standing one.
entries.覡: Compound ideogram: 巫 (shaman) + 見 (to see).
entries.覦: Phono-semantic compound: 俞 (phonetic) + 見 (to see, semantic).
entries.親:
Bronze script: Phono-semantic compound: 辛 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).

Seal script: Phono-semantic compound: 𣓀 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic). The left part (a chisel with a tree at the bottom to indicate "hazelnut branch" used as a whip) was then stylized as 亲, which originally is a variant of 辛, the chisel.
entries.覬: Phono-semantic compound: 豈 (phonetic) + 見 (to see, semantic).
entries.覭: Phono-semantic compound: 冥 (phonetic) + 見 (to see, semantic).
entries.覰: Phono-semantic compound: 虘 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).
entries.観:
Variant of 觀. Simplified from 觀. Compare 権.

The modern Japanese usage is of reform (shinjitai) nature.
entries.覷: Phono-semantic compound: 虛 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).
entries.覽: Phono-semantic compound: 監 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).
entries.觀: Phono-semantic compound: 雚 (phonetic) + 見 (see, semantic).
entries.见: Simplified form of 見 from cursive script (East Asia).
entries.观: Simplified from 觀. Same simplification of phonetic occurs in 权.
entries.角: Pictogram – a horn. A conservative version is 𧢲. Similar but unrelated to 甬, 用, and the bottom part of 備.
entries.解: Compound ideogram: 角 (horn) + 刀 (knife) + 牛 (cow) – a knife separates a horn from a cow, i.e. “cut up (an ox)”.
entries.觤: Phono-semantic compound: 角 (horn, semantic) + 危 (phonetic)
entries.触:
Unorthodox variant Simplified from 觸. found in the Ming dynasty orthographic dictionary 《字學三正》. Also found in 《宋元以來俗字譜》, a Variant Chinese character dictionary compiled in 1930.

Eventually adopted as an official simplified character by the People's Republic of China in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme.
entries.觩: Phono-semantic compound: 角 (horn, semantic) + 求 (phonetic)
entries.觶: Phono-semantic compound: 角 (horn, semantic) + 單 (phonetic).
entries.觿: Phono-semantic compound: 角 (horn, semantic) + 巂 (phonetic).
entries.言:
Ideogram – From 口 and ▽(possibly original form of 弋, marking location). Later: from 口 and 辛 or 䇂 (possibly mixed with 舌).

Possibly related to the semantic family of 舌 ("protruding/emerging", opposite to 音 "converging/covering") or 語 ("facing/front"). May also relate to 獻, 諺, and 唁 ("formal presentation/declaration").

See also 音.
entries.訃: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 卜 (phonetic).
entries.討:
Phono-semantic compound: 肘 (phonetic) + 言 (semantic).

Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as an Compound ideogram: 言 (speech) + 寸 (hand) – rectify.
entries.訓: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 川 (phonetic). It conveys the meaning of "preaching a teaching."
entries.訕: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 山 (phonetic)
entries.記: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech; words, semantic) + 己 (phonetic).
entries.訛: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 化 (phonetic)
entries.訟: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 公 (phonetic).
entries.訢: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 斤 (phonetic).
entries.訥: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 內 (inside, phonetic)
entries.訪: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (talk, semantic) + 方 (phonetic).
entries.設: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (semantic) + 埶 (phonetic). 埶 in this character initially appears as an ancient short form ⿰𡉣攴.
entries.許: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech; words, semantic) + 午 (phonetic).
entries.訴: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word, speak, semantic) + 斥 (accuse, blame, phonetic) – to accuse verbally.
entries.訹: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 朮 (phonetic)
entries.証: Simplified from 證. Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 正 (phonetic). The character originally conveyed the meaning of "to admonish" and was later used in the sense of "proof" or "evidence."
entries.詈: Compound ideogram: 网 (net) + 言 (speech; word). The net is perhaps a reference to the act of punishing somebody after a verbal abuse when such an abuse is considered an offence. The original version is 𧧧.
entries.詍: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 世 (phonetic).
entries.詔: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word; speech, semantic) + 召 (phonetic)
entries.詞: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 司 (phonetic).
entries.詣:
By Shuowen and ja:字統#字通, and following Zhengzhang (2003), a Phono-semantic compound: 言 (semantic) + 旨 (phonetic).

Alternatively, Compound ideogram: 言 (speech) + 旨 (delicious) — word use so skilled as to be delicious. The first interpretation is seemingly most accepted.
entries.詥: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 合 (phonetic).
entries.詩: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic) – poetry is a form of language, speech.
entries.詭: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 危 (phonetic).
entries.詰: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 吉 (phonetic). It expresses the meaning of inquiring in detail.
entries.話: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word, semantic) + 𠯑 (phonetic). The right component is not related to 舌.
entries.詳: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 羊 (phonetic).
entries.詵: Shuowen: Compound ideogram: 言 (to say, semantic) + 先 (to advance, phonetic).
entries.詹: Compound ideogram: 言 (words, to speak) + 八 (breath coming from the mouth; divide) + 厃 (danger) – speak too much. In the original version, the component 厃 was missing.
entries.詺: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (words, semantic) + 名 (phonetic).
entries.詻: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.誅: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 朱 (phonetic).
entries.誇: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (words, language, semantic) + 夸 (phonetic)
entries.認: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 忍 (phonetic).
entries.誓: Phono-semantic compound: 折 (phonetic) + 言 (speech, semantic).
entries.誕: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word, speech, semantic) + 延 (phonetic).
entries.誘: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word, language, semantic) + 秀 (phonetic).
entries.語:
Phono-semantic compound: 言 (semantic) + 吾 (phonetic).

Part of a *ŋa- word family centred on "to face; to respond to": 御, 禦, 圉, 迓, 逆, 晤, 忤. The original sense was likely "to face someone with speech; speech directed at an interlocutor", as opposed to 言, which denotes the speech act itself. Compare: 直言曰言，論難曰語.
entries.誠: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 成 (phonetic).
entries.誡: Compound ideogram: 言 (speech, semantic) + 戒 (guard against, phonetic).
entries.誤: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 吳 (phonetic) – to speak an error.
entries.誰: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speak, semantic) + 隹 (phonetic).
entries.課: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (to say, semantic) + 果 (phonetic) – to assess; to examine.
entries.誷: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 罔 (phonetic)
entries.談: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 炎 (phonetic).
entries.請: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 青 (phonetic).
entries.諍: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 爭 (conflict, phonetic).
entries.諏: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (talk, discuss, semantic) + 取 (take, select, phonetic).
entries.論: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 侖 (phonetic).
entries.諠: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 宣 (phonetic).
entries.諢: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).
entries.諧: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 皆 (phonetic).
entries.諫: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 柬 (phonetic).
entries.諮: Phono-semantic compound: 咨 (to consult, phonetic) + 言 (speak, semantic).
entries.諰: Compound ideogram: 言 (speech, semantic) + 思 (to think, phonetic).
entries.諳: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 音 (phonetic).
entries.諶: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 甚 (phonetic).
entries.諼: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 爰 (phonetic).
entries.諾: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word, speak, semantic) + 若 (like this; such, phonetic) — to answer affirmatively.
entries.謄: Phono-semantic compound: 朕 (phonetic) + 言 (say, semantic)
entries.謊: Originally written as 詤. Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 荒 (phonetic)
entries.謌: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 哥 (phonetic).
entries.謎: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 迷 (to be lost, phonetic).
entries.謗: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech; words, semantic) + 旁 (phonetic).
entries.謙: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 兼 (phonetic). It expresses the state of being respectful or reverent.
entries.講: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 冓 (phonetic).
entries.謝: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (word; speech, semantic) + 射 (phonetic).
entries.謢: Found in the 《敬使君碑陰》 Stele#China from the Eastern Wei period (534 to 550 AD).
entries.謴: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 貫 (phonetic).
entries.謹: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 堇 (phonetic) – to speak caution.
entries.謺: Phono-semantic compound: 執 (phonetic) + 言 (say, semantic)
entries.譀: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (words; speech, semantic) + 敢 (phonetic).
entries.譆: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 喜 (phonetic).
entries.譊: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (to speak, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic)
entries.譐: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 尊 (phonetic)
entries.識: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 戠 (phonetic).
entries.譜: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (sound, semantic) + 普 (phonetic).
entries.譞: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 睘 (phonetic)
entries.譡: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 當 (phonetic).
entries.警: Phono-semantic compound: 敬 (phonetic) + 言 (spoken language, speech, semantic).
entries.譯: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 睪 (phonetic).
entries.議: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (talk, semantic) + 義 (phonetic).
entries.譱: From 誩 ("say a lot") + 羊 ("goat" [=offering]), with the implied meaning of "virtuous."
entries.譲: Simplified from 讓. The modern Japanese usage is of reform (shinjitai) nature.
entries.譵: Found in the historical Chinese dictionaries Yupian 《玉篇》 and Longkan Shoujian 《龍龕手鑑》.
entries.譽: Phono-semantic compound: 與 (phonetic) + 言 (say, semantic).
entries.讀: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (to say, semantic) + 𧶠 (phonetic).
entries.讎: Phono-semantic compound: 雔 (two birds, phonetic) + 言 (argue, semantic).
entries.讒: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 毚 (phonetic)
entries.讓: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (semantic) + 襄 (phonetic) – to criticize; to reproach.
entries.讕: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 闌 (phonetic).
entries.讖: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (words; speech; language, semantic) + 韱 (phonetic).
entries.讚: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (say, semantic) + 贊 (phonetic).
entries.讜: Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 黨 (phonetic).
entries.讠: From cursive script (East Asia) of 訁.
entries.认:
Simplified from 認.

In current form, a Phono-semantic compound: 言 (speech, semantic) + 人 (phonetic).
entries.让:
Simplified from 讓.

Simplification derived from various Wu dialects, in which 上 and 讓 are homophonous.
entries.证: Simplified from 証. Since 証 was also used as a variant of 證, 证 also became the simplified form of 證.
entries.谷: Pictogram – valley (口) in between two mountain walls represented by near-parallel lines. The original version is 𠔌. See also 㕣.
entries.豆: Pictogram – some kind of container. Borrowed phonetically for the plant name. Displaced Old Chinese 菽. Unrelated to the bottom part of 豊.
entries.豇: Phono-semantic compound: 豆 (bean, semantic) + 工 (phonetic).
entries.豈: Possibly a variation of 壴 with the top part modified. May have been the original form of 凱.
entries.豉:
Phono-semantic compound: 豆 (bean, semantic) + 支 (phonetic).

The orthodox form in Shuowen was 𢻃, which has 尗 instead of 豆.
entries.豊:
Originally an Compound ideogram: 壴 (drum) + 玨 (strings of jade) – ceremony. Original form of 禮.

In some bronze inscriptions, 壴 has been split into two, with 豆 on the bottom. Later scripts, including the seal script, have inherited this corruption, leading Shuowen to interpret this character as a Pictogram – containing 豆.

Due to similarity with the unrelated 豐, 豊 has also been used as one of its variants.
entries.豌: Phono-semantic compound: 豆 (bean; pea, semantic) + 宛 (phonetic).
entries.豎: Possibly Phono-semantic compound: 臤 (semantic) + 豆 (phonetic).
entries.豐:
Ideogram – The top component is 𠁳, a pot full of plants 丰 (abundance, plenty). The bottom component is 豆, which is another pot.

Unrelated to 豊, in which two strings of jade pieces 玨 are present. The top component of 豐 is unrelated to 山.
entries.豔: Originally 豓. Phono-semantic compound: 豐 (abundant, great, semantic) + 盇 (phonetic) (corrupted to 盍).
entries.豕:
Pictogram – a pig. Compare 亥, 𢑓 (male pig), and 豖 (castrated male pig). See also the original version on oracle bones of 敢.

Related to 㒸, in which however the pig is a phonetic component.
entries.豖:
Pictogram – of a male pig with the penis detached from his body, thus indicating a castrated male pig. See also the original version on oracle bones of 家, 豕, and 豭.

The interpretation of a shackled pig derives from the stylization of the character and belongs to folk etymology. Furthermore, Showen Jiezi interprets the character as a pig with a small foot at the bottom, indicating a pig tripping over itself; however, this interpretation is not linked to the original appearance of the character on oracle bones.
entries.豝: Phono-semantic compound: 豕 (pig; boar, semantic) + 巴 (phonetic).
entries.象: Pictogram – - pictographic representation of an elephant. ⺈ represents the trunk, 𫩏 represents the head, and 𧰨 represents the body.
entries.豦: Compound ideogram: 虍 (tiger) + 豕 (boar).A tiger on the top and a boar at the bottom that are fighting fiercely. Perhaps the original version of 劇.
entries.豨: Phono-semantic compound: 豕 (pig, semantic) + 希 (phonetic).
entries.豪: Phono-semantic compound: 高 (phonetic) + 豕 (pig, boar, semantic).
entries.豬: Phono-semantic compound: 豕 (pig, semantic) + 者 (phonetic).
entries.豭:
Originally a Pictogram – of a male pig with genitals visible. Compare 豕.

In the current form, Phono-semantic compound: 豕 (pig, semantic) + 叚 (phonetic).

Derivative: 家.
entries.豯: Phono-semantic compound: 豕 (pig, semantic) + 奚 (phonetic).
entries.豹: Phono-semantic compound: 豸 (beast; creature, semantic) + 勺 (phonetic). Pictogram – in the oracle bone script.
entries.豺: Phono-semantic compound: 豸 (creature, semantic) + 才 (phonetic).
entries.貌:
Phono-semantic compound: 豹 (phonetic) + 皃 (looks, semantic).

Originally written as 皃, which is a Pictogram – of the face.
entries.貓:
Phono-semantic compound: 豸 (semantic) + 苗 (phonetic).

Ma Xulun suggested that 豸 was the original character.
entries.貝: Pictogram – cowrie used as currency in ancient China. Unrelated to the original version of 則. See also the top component of 得. Unrelated to 目.
entries.貞: Pictogram – - a ding (oracle bone script,; same as 鼎). Borrowed phonetically for “to divine”; however, bronze tripods in ancient China were sometimes used during rituals. Later, a new character was created by adding 卜 as a radical, hence a semantic component, thus getting 鼑 (oracle bone script; bronze script. The bottom component was stylized into the unrelated 貝 during the Warring States. Compare 𠟭 > 則.
entries.財: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 才 (phonetic).
entries.貧: Phono-semantic compound: 分 (phonetic) + 貝 (money, semantic). Since the phonetic means "to divide", a possible mnemonic is "to divide one's money".
entries.貨: Phono-semantic compound: 化 (phonetic) + 貝 (shell, money, semantic) – valuable goods.
entries.販: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (cowry, semantic) + 反 (phonetic).
entries.貪: Phono-semantic compound: 今 (open mouth, phonetic) + 貝 (money, semantic).
entries.貫:
Pictogram: two 貝 strung together.

Shuowen mistakes the character for a compound of 毌 + 貝.
entries.責:
Phono-semantic compound: 朿 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry; money, semantic) – tax; debt.

Top component now resembles 生 (without the diagonal stroke) – compare 青, 素.
entries.貯: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shellfish, semantic) + 宁 (phonetic).
entries.貰: Phono-semantic compound: 世 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowrie, currency, semantic).
entries.貳: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (semantic) + 弍 (two, phonetic).
entries.貴: Simplified from 䝿. Phono-semantic compound: 臾 (phonetic) + 貝 (money cowrie, semantic).
entries.貶: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 乏 (phonetic).
entries.買:
Compound ideogram: 网 (net) + 貝 (money cowrie). The original version is 𧵽.

 consider it to be a Phono-semantic compound: 羅 (phonetic) + 貝 (money cowrie, semantic).
entries.貸: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 代 (phonetic). The character originally conveyed the meaning of "to give" or "to bestow," and later came to be used with the meaning of "to lend."
entries.費: Phono-semantic compound: 弗 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry, semantic).
entries.貼: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 占 (phonetic).
entries.貿: Phono-semantic compound: 卯 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowrie, semantic).
entries.賀: Phono-semantic compound: 加 (phonetic) + 貝 (shellfish money, semantic).
entries.賁: Phono-semantic compound: 卉 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry, semantic) for the reading bì (*prals). The character was borrowed for the word 奔 in ancient times, hence its reading bēn (*pɯːn).
entries.賂: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.賃: Phono-semantic compound: 任 (phonetic) + 貝 (shell, money, semantic) – a kind of payment. 任 has meaning of “duty, employment”, so connotations of “money paid for employment (hire)” or “money that one has a duty to pay (rent)”.
entries.賄: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (cowry; money, semantic) + 有 (phonetic).
entries.資: Phono-semantic compound: 次 (phonetic) + 貝 (shell-money, semantic) – “property, resource”.
entries.賈: Phono-semantic compound: 襾 (phonetic) + 貝 (shellfish, semantic).
entries.賊:
Phono-semantic compound: 則 (phonetic) + 戈 (weapon, semantic).

This was later reinterpreted as a compound of 貝 and 戎 to produce the modern form.
entries.賑: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (money, semantic) + 辰 (phonetic) – having money, giving money (support).
entries.賕: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 求 (phonetic)
entries.賖: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 余 (phonetic).
entries.賜: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, money, semantic) + 易 (phonetic).
entries.賞: Phono-semantic compound: 商 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry, semantic).
entries.賠: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 咅 (phonetic). It expresses the idea of “atoning for” or “making amends.”
entries.賢: Phono-semantic compound: 臤 (phonetic) + 貝 (money, semantic) – worthy, valuable (like money)
entries.賣:
Originally 𧷓, an Compound ideogram: 出 (go out, semantic) + 買 (buy, phonetic).

出, which indicates exoactive semantics, was eventually reduced to the etymologically unrelated 士.

Unrelated to 𧶠, which is used as a phonetic component in a number of characters.
entries.賦: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 武 (phonetic). It expresses the meaning of collecting taxes.
entries.賬: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 長 (phonetic).
entries.賭: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 者 (phonetic). It expresses the meaning “to wager” or “to bet.”
entries.賰: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell; money, semantic) + 春 (phonetic).
entries.賴: Phono-semantic compound: 剌 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry, semantic) – to profit.
entries.賸: Phono-semantic compound: 朕 (phonetic) + 貝 (shellfish, semantic)
entries.賺:
Originally as 𧸖.

In the current form: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (semantic) + 兼 (phonetic).
entries.賻: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (money, semantic) + 尃 (phonetic).
entries.購: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shellfish, semantic) + 冓 (phonetic).
entries.賽: Phono-semantic compound: 塞 (phonetic) + 貝 (shell, semantic).
entries.贄: Phono-semantic compound: 執 (phonetic) + 貝 (valuable, semantic)
entries.贅: Compound ideogram: 敖 (ramble; travel) + 貝 (money) – "money that goes away and ought to be taken back" – originally meaning a kind of collateral, or pawn. 贅 later was borrowed for sound to signify "belonging; attachment; linking", which is closer to the modern meaning of "superfluous".
entries.贊:
Originally 賛. Compound ideogram: 㚘 + 貝 (money) – to help with money.

Now Phono-semantic compound: 兟 (phonetic) + 貝 (money, semantic).
entries.贋: Phono-semantic compound: 雁 (phonetic) + 貝 (money, semantic).
entries.贏: Phono-semantic compound: 𦝠 (phonetic) + 貝 (cowry; money, semantic).
entries.贖: Phono-semantic compound: 貝 (shell, semantic) + 𧶠 (phonetic); the phonetic was originally 𧷏 and has later become graphically similar to the unrelated 賣.
entries.贛:
In the bronze script, it was attested as 𬔧, an Compound ideogram: 章 (jade ornament) + 丮 (to hold) – holding a jade ornament > “to bestow”. The 丮 component corrupts into 欠 or 次, and later to 夂 or a variant with 二 under 夂. An additional semantic component 貝 was often added. The 二 and 貝 components combine to form an emergent phonetic component 貢.

Shuowen reinterprets it as a Phono-semantic compound: 竷 (phonetic) + 貝 (shell; money, semantic), but this is not supported by earlier scripts.
entries.贝: Simplified form of 貝 in cursive script (East Asia).
entries.购:
Simplified from 購.

Compare 沟, from 溝.
entries.赞:
Simplified from 贊.

Also Simplified from 讚.
entries.赤:
Compound ideogram: 大 (person, big) + 火 (fire) – the color of fire (a person by a fire). The original version is 𤆍.

The man on top is simplified as 土 as in 去 and 走 (< 𧺆). The fire is stylized as well, but an intermediate and obsolete variant is 灻.
entries.赦: In the bronze script, it was written as 𢼜, a Phono-semantic compound: 亦 (phonetic) + 攴 (hand holding a stick, semantic). In later scripts, the phonetic component was replaced with 赤.
entries.走:
Pictogram: a running man. An additional 止 was added later. The variant form 𧺆 preserves the form in the Small Seal Script.

In the modern form, the top component (夭) is simplified to the unrelated 土 and the bottom part is stylized as 龰. See also the top component of 去 and 赤.

As with 圭, there are two separate vertical strokes, not a single one.
entries.赴: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (running, semantic) + 卜 (phonetic).
entries.趁: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (to run, semantic) + 㐱 (phonetic).
entries.超: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (run, semantic) + 召 (phonetic).
entries.越: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (to walk or run, semantic) + 戉 (phonetic) — to go over; to cross.
entries.趋: Unorthodox variant Simplified from 趨. First attested in Cihai 《辭海》, a semi-encyclopedic dictionary published in China from 1936-1938.
entries.趒: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (walk, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.趖: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (walking, semantic) + 坐 (phonetic)
entries.趟: Considered a 後起字. Phono-semantic compound: 走 (run, semantic) + 尚 (phonetic).
entries.趣: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (walk, semantic) + 取 (phonetic) – to hasten (walking) towards an object of interest.
entries.趩: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (walk, semantic) + 異 (phonetic)
entries.趬: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (walk, semantic) + 堯 (phonetic)
entries.足: Pictogram – of a leg; similar to 疋.
entries.趴: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 八 (phonetic).
entries.趺: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 夫 (phonetic).
entries.趾: Compound ideogram: 足 (foot, semantic) + 止 (foot, phonetic). Originally written 止.
entries.趿: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 及 (phonetic).
entries.跋: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 犮 (phonetic).
entries.跌: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 失 (phonetic).
entries.跍: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 古 (phonetic)
entries.跏: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 加 (phonetic).
entries.跑: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 包 (phonetic).
entries.跔: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 句 (phonetic).
entries.跙: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 且 (phonetic)
entries.跛: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 皮 (phonetic).
entries.距: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 巨 (phonetic).
entries.跟: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 艮 (phonetic).
entries.跡: Variant of 迹 using a semantic component with similar meaning; see there for more. Current form is a Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 亦 (phonetic).
entries.跣: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 先 (phonetic).
entries.跪: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 危 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component shows (perhaps by chance) a person kneeling on the ground.
entries.跱: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 寺 (phonetic)
entries.跳: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.践: Simplified from 踐. for Japanese shinjitai and Simplified from 踐. for simplified Chinese.
entries.跺: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 朵 (phonetic).
entries.踅: Phono-semantic compound: 折 (phonetic) + 足 (foot, semantic).
entries.踊: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (legs, semantic) + 甬 (phonetic)
entries.踎: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 否 (phonetic).
entries.踏: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 沓 (phonetic).
entries.踔: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 卓 (phonetic).
entries.踝: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 果 (phonetic).
entries.踞: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 居 (phonetic).
entries.踟: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 知 (phonetic).
entries.踢: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 易 (phonetic).
entries.踩: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 采 (phonetic).
entries.踪: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 宗 (phonetic).
entries.踭: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 爭 (phonetic).
entries.踰: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 俞 (phonetic).
entries.踴: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 勇 (phonetic).
entries.踵: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 重 (phonetic).
entries.踼: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 昜 (phonetic).
entries.踽: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 禹 (phonetic)
entries.蹀: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 枼 (phonetic).
entries.蹄: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 帝 (phonetic).
entries.蹇: Phono-semantic compound: 寒 (phonetic) + 足 (foot, semantic).
entries.蹉: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 差 (phonetic).
entries.蹓: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 留 (phonetic).
entries.蹛: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 帶 (phonetic)
entries.蹜: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 宿 (phonetic)
entries.蹟: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 責 (phonetic).
entries.蹢: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 啇 (phonetic).
entries.蹤: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 從 (follow, phonetic)
entries.蹦:
Simplified from 崩.

Phono-semantic compound: 足 (semantic) + 崩 (phonetic).
entries.蹩: Phono-semantic compound: 敝 (phonetic) + 足 (foot, semantic).
entries.蹬: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 登 (phonetic).
entries.蹭: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 曾 (phonetic).
entries.蹲: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 尊 (phonetic) – to sit.
entries.蹴: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 就 (phonetic).
entries.蹼: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 菐 (phonetic).
entries.躂: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 達 (phonetic).
entries.躅: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 蜀 (phonetic).
entries.躍: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 翟 (phonetic).
entries.躑: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 鄭 (phonetic).
entries.躒: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 樂 (phonetic).
entries.躕: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 廚 (phonetic).
entries.躡: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot, semantic) + 聶 (phonetic).
entries.身: Pictogram: from a pictograph of a pregnant woman. See also the reversed version 㐆. Unrelated to 射.
entries.躬: Phono-semantic compound: 身 (body, semantic) + 弓 (phonetic).
entries.躮: Kokuji (created in Japan)., formed as an Compound ideogram: 分 + 身, a ligature of 分身.
entries.躲: Phono-semantic compound: 身 (body, semantic) + 朵 (to move, phonetic).
entries.躺: Phono-semantic compound: 身 (body, semantic) + 尚 (phonetic).
entries.躾: Kokuji (created in Japan). composed as an Compound ideogram: 身 (body) + 美 (beauty).
entries.軀: Phono-semantic compound: 身 (body, semantic) + 區 (phonetic)
entries.軄: Phono-semantic compound: 身 (body, semantic) + 戠 (phonetic).
entries.軈:
Kokuji (created in Japan).

Compound ideogram: 身 (body) + 應 (reply, adapt/apply to), meaning “to immediately ready oneself to (something)”.
entries.車:
Pictogram – originally a carriage seen from above. In the oracle bone script, there were large wheels on both sides and a central shaft at the front. 

Unrelated to 倝 and 朝.
entries.軋: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (cart, semantic) + 乙 (phonetic)
entries.軍:
Phono-semantic compound: semantic 車 + phonetic 勹. The phonetic component here is not 勹, but the original form of 螾, which also acts as the phonetic component of 旬, 勻 and 云. 

The Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as Compound ideogram: 車 (cart; chariot) + 勹 (to surround).
entries.軒: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 干 (phonetic)
entries.軛:
Originally written 戹 and later 厄.

Afterwards 車 was added to differentiate, forming Compound ideogram: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 厄 (yoke, phonetic).
entries.軟:
Originally written 輭, a Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 耎 (phonetic). 耎 turned into 欠 over time due to a popular variant.

The meaning of the carriage is not fully clear. It could be linked to the synonym 柔, which indicates the wood soft enough to be cut, or it could indicate the concept of being tired and weak after dragging a heavy carriage, hence "soft"; the right component could add part of the meaning, since it originally depicts a man under the rain, hence getting soaked (perhaps while dragging a heavy carriage). The modern component 欠 depicts a man kneeling with an open mouth, perhaps while breathing due to exhaustion.
entries.軸: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (cart, carriage, semantic) + 由 (to pass through, phonetic) — the axle that passes through a cartwheel.
entries.軹: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (cart, semantic) + 只 (phonetic).
entries.軾: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (cart, semantic) + 式 (phonetic)
entries.較:
Phono-semantic compound: 車 (vehicle, semantic) + 交 (phonetic).

The original phonetic component was 爻, later corrupted to 交
entries.輍: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (chariot, semantic) + 谷 (phonetic)
entries.輒: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (cart, semantic) + 耴 (phonetic).
entries.輕: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 巠 (phonetic). The word originally referred to a kind of light carriage.
entries.輛: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (vehicle, semantic) + 兩 (phonetic).
entries.輝: Phono-semantic compound: 光 (light; bright, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).
entries.輞: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 罔 (phonetic).
entries.輟: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage; chariot, semantic) + 叕 (phonetic).
entries.輪: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 侖 (phonetic).
entries.輭: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 耎 (phonetic). Original form of 軟, see there for more.
entries.輿: Phono-semantic compound: 舁 (phonetic) + 車 (carriage, semantic).
entries.轄: Phono-semantic compound: 害 (phonetic) + 車 (cart, semantic) – linchpin.
entries.轅: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 袁 (phonetic).
entries.轉: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 專 (phonetic).
entries.轊:
Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 彗 (phonetic).

Originally written 軎, see there for more.
entries.轍: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (wagon, semantic) + 徹 (phonetic) – wagon tracks.
entries.轐: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 菐 (phonetic)
entries.轔: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 粦 (phonetic).
entries.轘: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (carriage, semantic) + 睘 (phonetic)
entries.轡: Compound ideogram: 絲 (rope) + 軎 (carriage part).
entries.轢: Phono-semantic compound: 車 (chariot, semantic) + 樂 (phonetic).
entries.车: From cursive script (East Asia) of 車; compare 東 → 东.
entries.辛:
Pictogram – Older oracle bone forms of 辛 (⿱∇木) depict newly grown tree shoots, acting as the original ideogram for 新 and 薪. In 新, the top of the axe component (斤) aligns with the bottom of ∇, signifying the chopping of wood.

Traditionally interpreted as a pictogram of a tool—a chisel, awl, or spike—used to mark slaves and criminals. However, some scholars suggest this view stems from a conflation with the character 䇂.
entries.辞: Simplified from ⿰⿱厶古辛. In China, first attested in the《張郎墓》stele (300 A.D.). In Japan, first attested in the《長谷寺法華説相圖記》stele (686 A.D.).
entries.辠: Compound ideogram: 自 + 辛, hence "nose" + "chisel; knife to mark prisoners" to indicate the concept of criminal, perhaps with a reference to cutting the nose as a form of punishment. Later, 辠 was substituted by 𦋛 (> 罪), originally a net for fishing, due to the similarity of the former character to 皇, which represents the Emperor.
entries.辥: Phono-semantic compound: 辛 (chisel-like knife (crime), semantic) + 𡴎 (phonetic) – Sin.
entries.辦: Phono-semantic compound: 辡 (phonetic) + 力 (strength, semantic).
entries.辧: Phono-semantic compound: 辡 (phonetic) + 刀 (knife, semantic).
entries.辨: From 辧, a Phono-semantic compound: 辡 (phonetic) + 刀 (knife, semantic). However, the phonetic component (the reduplication of the knife to mark prisoners) perhaps symbolizes two prisoners accusing each other, hence two different versions, which then leads to the concept of "discriminate".
entries.辭:
In oracle bone and Western Zhou bronze inscriptions, the left component 𤔔 depicts hands drawing out silk threads with a 壬/工-shaped element at the centre (perhaps a reeling tool or a midpoint marker), representing the act of ordering and sorting silk. The right component is 𬔖 (original form of 刈), also carrying the sense "to put in order"; it sometimes appears with 口 appended, and some forms further prefix 言 at the far left. Compare 𤔲, a related graph using 司 on the right, attested in bronze inscriptions for both 司 and 嗣.

The right-side 辛 of the received form is a graphic corruption of 𬔖, functioning as a phonophoric supplying *l-type phonetic information. The left component 𤔔 may itself carry a phonetic hint related to 絲, supplying *s-; together they yield the *sl- cluster of the word.

Within the *slə phonetic neighbourhood, several semantic clusters are discernible: (a) continuation, succession, resemblance (e.g. 嗣, 似); (b) presentation, bestowal, feeding (e.g. 祠, 飼); (c) display, arrangement, ordering (e.g. 肆, 司); (d) fibre, cordage, spinning (e.g. 絲). The semantic development of 辭 itself likely ran: to draw out and order silk threads → to sort out a legal case; plea, testimony → words, rhetoric → to take leave; to decline.
entries.辰:
Pictogram – a kind of agricultural tool used for tilling the fields and removing weeds (;), possibly made of a kind of large clam 蜃.

Alternatively, it could be a Pictogram – of a person holding onto a cliff – original character of 振.
entries.農:
Compound ideogram: 林 (vegetation) + 辰 (hoe) — to remove weeds.

In the bronze inscriptions, a semantic 田 was added.

The 林 later corrupted into 𦥑 and the 田 into 囟 and in the clerical script they finally combined into 曲.
entries.辵: Compound ideogram: 彳 (walk) + 止 (foot” or “to stop). A more conservative and obsolete version is 𣥆. The bottom part is now stylized as 龰.
entries.边: Simplified from 邊. Officially adopted as the simplified form of 邊 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (s:漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
entries.込: Kokuji (created in Japan). Compound ideogram: 辵 (walk) + 入 (in; enter).
entries.迈: Simplified from 邁. Officially adopted as the simplified form of 邁 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (s:漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
entries.近: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 斤 (phonetic) – to be near something.
entries.迓: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (travel, semantic) + 牙 (phonetic).
entries.返: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 反 (to return, phonetic). It originally conveyed the meaning of "to return along the path one came from" and, by extension, came to signify the idea of "to restore" or "to revert."
entries.进:
Simplified from 進. in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme by the People's Republic of China. This character is not known to have existed before that. 

In simplified form, Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (semantic) + 井 (phonetic).
entries.远:
Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 元 (phonetic).

Unorthodox variant Simplified from 遠. found in various Movable type#Metal movable type in China copies of Classic Chinese Novels. First attested in 《宋元以來俗字譜》, a Variant Chinese character dictionary compiled in 1930 that records unorthodox forms (俗字) that have existed since the Song dynasty.

Eventually adopted as an official Simplified Chinese by the People's Republic of China in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme.
entries.迟:
Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (motion, semantic) + 尺 (phonetic).

Simplified from 遲. in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme by the People's Republic of China. This character is not known to have existed prior to that.
entries.迢: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 召 (phonetic).
entries.述: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 朮 (phonetic).
entries.迷: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 米 (phonetic)
entries.迸: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 并 (phonetic).
entries.迹:
Corrupted form of 𨒪 (found in Bronze script): Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (move, semantic) + 朿 (phonetic) (漢語多功能字庫).

Current form is Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (move, semantic) + 亦 (phonetic).
entries.追: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 𠂤 (phonetic) – moving after, pursuit. See also 師 and 官.
entries.退:
In oracle bone script, Compound ideogram: 皀 (food vessel) + 夊 (downward foot) – to leave the table after eating. Variants that depicted the vessel as 酉 or 豆 were common. Bronze inscriptions added 彳 to emphasize the action of walking away.

In the modern form the vessel 皀 has simplified to the unrelated 艮, similar to ⾷, 即, 既, 郷.

Shuowen misinterprets the seal script form as Compound ideogram: 辵 (move) + 夊 (walk) + 日 (sun) – to walk away from the sun, to retreat.
entries.送: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 灷 (phonetic).
entries.逃: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 兆 (phonetic).
entries.逆:
Compound ideogram: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 屰 (go against, phonetic) – going in the opposite direction, contrary, disobedient.

Also originally written 屰, see there for more.
entries.透:
Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walking, semantic) + 秀 (phonetic).

This character is not attested in the oracle bone script or bronze inscriptions.
entries.逐: Compound ideogram: 辵 (walking) + 豕 (pig) – "to chase; pursue".
entries.逑: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 求 (phonetic).
entries.逘: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (motion, semantic) + 矣 (phonetic).
entries.這:
Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 言 (phonetic).

The character was originally a verb meaning “to meet”, whose modern pronunciation is yàn. It was later borrowed for the proximal demonstrative “this/here”, by a confusion in medieval handwriting with 遮.
entries.逝: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walking, semantic) + 折 (phonetic)
entries.造:
Unclear. Generally considered to be unrelated to 告 in its original form.

The bronze script forms are identified by 漢語多功能字庫 as being Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 屮 (phonetic) + 口 (semantic) – “to go, to arrive”.

Shuowen incorrectly identifies it as a Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.連:
Compound ideogram: 辵 (to walk) + 車 (chariot) – man-drawn carriage.

According to Duan Yucai, 聯 and 連 are two characters for a same word, with the former used in the Zhou dynasty and the latter in the Han dynasty.
entries.週: Considered a 後起字. Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walking, semantic) + 周 (phonetic).
entries.進:
Compound ideogram: 辵 (walk) + 隹 (short-tail bird). A bird can only walk forward, not backward, hence implying "forward". Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as

Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (semantic) + 閵 (phonetic).
entries.逵: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 坴 (phonetic).
entries.逷: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 易 (phonetic)
entries.逸: Oracle bone script, Compound ideogram: 止 + 㚔. Later, Compound ideogram: 辵 + 兔.
entries.遂: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (semantic) + 㒸 (phonetic). The original version is 㒸, which has no reference to pigs (the pig is a phonetic component).
entries.遅:
Variant of 遲. Simplified from 遲. 𡱝 is a variant of 犀.

The modern Japanese usage is of reform (shinjitai) nature.
entries.遊: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 斿 (phonetic).
entries.運: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (motion, semantic) + 軍 (phonetic).
entries.遍: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk; movement, semantic) + 扁 (phonetic).
entries.過: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 咼 (phonetic).
entries.遏: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 曷 (phonetic).
entries.道: First attested in early Western Zhou bronze inscriptions as a 行 (road) + 首 (head), later augmented with 又 (寸) or 止 in the middle and late periods. The 亍 on the right eventually disappeared, leading to the semantic components combining into 辵 in the seal script.
entries.達:
Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (semantic) + 羍 (phonetic).

Note that inner component is not 幸 – these are not related, and there is an extra stroke in 達 (three horizontal strokes at the bottom, not two).
entries.遘: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 冓 (phonetic).
entries.遛: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walking, semantic) + 留 (phonetic)
entries.遜: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 孫 (phonetic).
entries.遠: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 袁 (phonetic).
entries.遡:
The original character is 㴑. Phono-semantic compound: 水 (water, semantic) + 㡿 (phonetic). It expresses the meaning “to go upstream” or “to go back.”

The commonly used modern character is based on a different form. Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 朔 (phonetic).
entries.遣:
Originally 𠳋, an Compound ideogram – in the oracle bone script: two 又 in a configuration of commanding + 𠂤 – “to send; to dispatch”.

The 辵 component was later added in some bronze inscriptions, which is retained in the modern glyph.
entries.遨: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 敖 (ramble, phonetic).
entries.適: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (semantic) + 啻 (phonetic), hence the original form is 𨗁. The inner component was then stylized into 啇.
entries.遬: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 欶 (phonetic).
entries.遭: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 曹 (phonetic) – to meet with (on the road).
entries.遮: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (road, semantic) + 庶 (numerous, phonetic)
entries.遲: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (motion, semantic) + 犀 (phonetic) – to move slowly, to be late.
entries.遵: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 尊 (phonetic). However, the phonetic component (offering a vessel of wine) conveys the concept of veneration and showing respect, which is linked to "follow; obey".
entries.遷: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (movement, semantic) + 䙴 (phonetic). It conveys the idea of "ascending to a high place" and, by extension, is used to mean "transfer" or "move."
entries.選:
Phono-semantic compound: 止 (semantic) + 巽 (phonetic).

Xu Shen argues that the original meaning was to respectfully reject and send someone back; to choose also implies rejecting others, hence the meaning.
entries.遺: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (move, semantic) + 貴 (phonetic).
entries.遼: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 尞 (phonetic).
entries.避: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (to walk, semantic) + 辟 (phonetic).
entries.邃: Phono-semantic compound: 穴 (cave, semantic) + 遂 (phonetic).
entries.還: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 睘 (phonetic) – to go back; to return.
entries.邊: Originally 臱. Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walking; movement, semantic) + 臱 (phonetic). The semantic component 辵 (now 辶) was added during bronze inscriptions.
entries.邏: Phono-semantic compound: 辵 (walk, semantic) + 羅 (phonetic).
entries.邑: Compound ideogram: 囗 (enclosure; city wall) + 卪 (kneeling person). The bottom part of the radical is unrelated to 巴 and the top component is most likely unrelated to the original version of 丁.
entries.邙: Phono-semantic compound: 亡 (phonetic) + 邑 (area, place, semantic).
entries.邠: Phono-semantic compound: 分 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.那:
Phono-semantic compound: 冉 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).

Originally the name of a state; later borrowed for a distal demonstrative.
entries.邨:
Phono-semantic compound: 屯 (phonetic) + 邑 (city; town, semantic).

See 村 for more.
entries.邪:
Phono-semantic compound: 牙 (phonetic) + 邑 (town; city, semantic).

The semantic component suggests that this character was originally used in a place name, which Shuowen suggests to be 琅邪. It was later borrowed for other meanings, the most prominent being “wrong; evil” (originally written as 衺).
entries.邯: Phono-semantic compound: 甘 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.邱:
Phono-semantic compound: 丘 (phonetic) + 邑 (city; town, semantic)

This character was created to observe the naming taboo of Confucius, whose real name was 孔丘.
entries.邲: Phono-semantic compound: 必 (phonetic) + 邑 (city; town, semantic)
entries.邸: Phono-semantic compound: 邑 (settlement, semantic) + 氐 (phonetic). It originally referred to a building where feudal lords stayed when visiting the capital, and by extension, represents the idea of a “residence” or “mansion.”
entries.邾: Phono-semantic compound: 朱 (phonetic) + 邑 (area; district, semantic).
entries.郅: Phono-semantic compound: 至 (phonetic) + 邑 (location, semantic).
entries.郇: Phono-semantic compound: 旬 (phonetic) + 邑 (state; city, semantic).
entries.郎: Phono-semantic compound: 良 (phonetic) + 邑 (county; town, semantic).
entries.郗: Phono-semantic compound: 希 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic)
entries.郝: Phono-semantic compound: 赤 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, town, semantic)
entries.郡: Phono-semantic compound: 邑 (city; town, semantic) + 君 (phonetic). It represents one of the ancient local administrative divisions.
entries.郢: Phono-semantic compound: 呈 (phonetic) + 邑 (place, semantic)
entries.部: Phono-semantic compound: 咅 (phonetic) + 邑 (semantic). It originally refers to a place in today's Gansu.
entries.郪: Phono-semantic compound: 妻 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.郭:
The original version on oracle bones shows a tall tower similar to 京 and 高 (< 髙) which perhaps was part of the outer city walls in ancient Chinese cities. At the bottom, there was an enclosed space 囗 to represent city walls or a city in general and another tower.

Later, the tower at the bottom was stylized like the unrelated 子 and the enclosed space was drawn as the unrelated 回. Hence, the whole character was written like 𩫖 and 𩫏. Sometimes, the second variant had the bottom part contracted into 十.

Eventually, 邑 was added to form an Compound ideogram: 𩫖 (tall building) + 邑 (city), hence 𩫩, sometimes simplified into 𨟍 – outer city walls with tall towers.

From clerical script, the 𩫖 became written as the unrelated 享 through the process of libian; the two characters are unrelated.
entries.郰: Phono-semantic compound: 取 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.郳: Phono-semantic compound: 兒 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.郵: Compound ideogram: 垂 (far, remote) + 邑 (city) – "relay station".
entries.郺: Phono-semantic compound: 多 (many, semantic) + 邕 (phonetic)
entries.都: Phono-semantic compound: 者 (phonetic) + 邑 (town, city, semantic).
entries.郾:
Phono-semantic compound: 匽 (phonetic) + 邑 (town; land, semantic).; "Alternative form of 燕"

Attested in bronze-script inscriptions in archaeological findings. Not used in classical texts.
entries.郿: Phono-semantic compound: 眉 (phonetic) + 邑 (area, semantic).
entries.鄂: Phono-semantic compound: 咢 (phonetic) + 邑 (area, semantic).
entries.鄆: Phono-semantic compound: 軍 (phonetic) + 邑 (place, semantic).
entries.鄉:
Compound ideogram: 𠨍 (two people facing each other) + 皀 (a round-mouthed food vessel) – to feast; the original script of 饗. The sense "village" was a result of phonetic borrowing or semantic shifting.

In early writing, the character was virtually indistinguishable from 卿. Semantically, 卿 and 鄉, likely cognates too, were both represented by the event depicted in the ideogram – 饗, which was central to the community life.

The right half is unrelated to 郎, as 良 in 鄉 was derived from 皀 during the formation of the clerical script.
entries.鄒: Phono-semantic compound: 芻 (phonetic) + 邑 (city; state, semantic)
entries.鄔: Phono-semantic compound: 烏 (phonetic) + 邑 (city; town, semantic).
entries.鄖: Phono-semantic compound: 員 (phonetic) + 邑 (area, semantic).
entries.鄙:
Originally written 啚.

Now Compound ideogram: 啚 (border town, phonetic) + 邑 (city) – border town.
entries.鄜: Simplified from 𨞻., a Phono-semantic compound: 麃 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.鄢: Phono-semantic compound: 焉 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.鄧: Phono-semantic compound: 登 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.鄲: Phono-semantic compound: 單 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.鄴: Phono-semantic compound: 業 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.鄽: Phono-semantic compound: 廛 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic)
entries.酅: Phono-semantic compound: 巂 (phonetic) + 邑 (city, semantic).
entries.酇: Phono-semantic compound: 贊 (phonetic) + 邑 (area, semantic).
entries.酉:
Pictogram – a wine vessel with a pointed bottom.

This is the original character for 酒. 

Compare 酋 (the vessel with added strokes indicating long-fermented alcohol or decoration) and 尊 (two hands holding the vessel).

Visually similar to but etymologically unrelated to 西 (which originally depicted a bird's nest).
entries.酋: Pictogram: Some exposed liquid (八) above an alcohol vessel (酉). See also 酒.
entries.配: Compound ideogram: 酉 (alcohol vessel) + 卩 (kneeling person).
entries.酎: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (wine, semantic) + 肘 (phonetic). (Duan Yucai)
entries.酒: Phono-semantic compound: 水 (semantic) + 酉 (phonetic). 酉 is the original pictogram for this word; 水 was added later to distinguish.
entries.酔: Unorthodox variant of 醉. The phonetic component 卆 is a variant of 卒.
entries.酗:
Written as 䣱 in Shuowen. Compare 醺.

Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 凶 (bad, phonetic).
entries.酢: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (wine vessel, semantic) + 乍 (phonetic). It conveys the meaning of "vinegar."
entries.酣: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 甘 (phonetic).
entries.酥: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 穌 (phonetic).
entries.酪: Phono-semantic compound: 各 (phonetic) + 酉 (alcohol; fermented drink, semantic)
entries.酬: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (liquor vessel; liquor, semantic) + 州 (phonetic)
entries.酯: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (oxygenated functional group, semantic) + 旨 (phonetic). Modelled after 脂 with a radical input from other oxygenated organic compounds such as 醇 and 酸, referring to ester linkages in lipids like glycerides.
entries.酳: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 胤 (phonetic).
entries.酵: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (semantic) + 孝 (phonetic) – fermenting in a vessel, making alcoholic drink. 孝 is composed of “young + old”, hence connotations of “aging (in a vase), fermentation”.
entries.酷: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcoholic drink vessel, semantic) + 告 (phonetic).
entries.醅: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 咅 (phonetic)
entries.醉: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcoholic drink, semantic) + 卒 (phonetic).
entries.醒: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (alcohol, semantic) + 星 (phonetic).
entries.醚: Compound ideogram: 酉 (oxygenated functional group) + 迷 (confusion), referring to the anesthetic properties of diethyl ether. 迷 also acts as the phonetic component.
entries.醜: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (phonetic) + 鬼 (ghost, demon, semantic) - demons are ugly in Chinese culture.
entries.醣: Phono-semantic compound: 酉 (oxygenated functional group, semantic) + 唐 (phonetic). 酉 is a common component in other organic compounds with oxygen, such as 醇, 醛 and 酮.
entries.醤:
Unofficial Japanese Simplified from 醬. (extended shinjitai); compare 奨.

entries.釋: Compound ideogram: 釆 (to distinguish, semantic) + 睪 (to release; to see, phonetic). In bronze scripts often written 睪//, see there for more.
entries.里: Compound ideogram: 田 (field) + 土 (soil; earth) – a measure of land and fields; mile; place.
entries.重:
Phono-semantic compound: 人 (man, semantic) + 東 (bag, phonetic) – a man carrying a bag. A glyph 土 was later added to show that the bag-carrying man is standing on the ground. From this composition (𡍺) is the current form. In the modern form, the man on top can be seen as 亻 (however, the upper part of the character is unrelated to 千).

See also 以, in which a person is carrying something, 央, in which a person is carrying a pole, and 年, in which a person is carrying the harvest.
entries.野: Phono-semantic compound: 田 (field, semantic) + 土 (earth, semantic) + 予 (phonetic).
entries.金:
Phono-semantic compound: semantic 士 or 王, + semantic 呂 (“two blocks of metal”) + phonetic 亼 (今). The blocks of metal were originally drawn as: and later as 丷.

Shuowen interprets it as an image of metal in the earth (Xu Shen writes "象金在土中形") with 亼 as phonetic. But the most ancient versions do not contain the pictogram of the earth.

Originally referred to copper, first used during the Copper Age and the Jade Age in China (hence before the Bronze Age, during which the first bronzes were produced); later the meaning was extended to metal as a whole, and then to gold.
entries.釘:
Phono-semantic compound: 金 (metal, semantic) + 丁 (phonetic).

Some theorize that 丁 originally meant “nail”. After subsequently losing this original meaning, the character was created to represent “nail” with the semantic element 金 added.

entries.鑄: Phono-semantic compound: 金 (metal, semantic) + 壽 (phonetic). Historical forms for this character feature large amounts of various decorative components, including 皿, 火, 寸, or 𦦡 = 𦥑 + 鬲, etc., indicating metal-casting. The phonetic value were signified by the optional component 𠃬, which also appeared in 壽.

entries.長:
Pictogram – an old man with long hair; an ancient variant still used is 镸 (e.g., ⾽ and 鬓).

Compare 彡 and the top component of 老 and its variant 考.
entries.門: Pictogram: a gate. Compare 戶, which is half of this character (𠁣).
entries.閂:
Compound ideogram: 門 (gate) + 一 (crossbar) ― a crossbar over a gate; sealing it closed.

Compare 關.
entries.閃: Compound ideogram: 門 (gate) + 人 (person) — a person running through a gate.
entries.閄: Compound ideogram: 門 (door) + 人 (human) - meaning "a man waiting beside a door to scare someone".
entries.閆: From the cursive script form of 閻. 闫 was adopted as the simplified form of 閻 in the second round of simplified Chinese characters.
entries.閉: Compound ideogram: 門 (door) + 材 (material; timber).
entries.開:
Compound ideogram: 門 (door) + 一 (latch and/or wooden pole that shuts a door) + 廾 (a pair of hands) — a pair of hands opening a latched door. 一 and 廾 are combined into 开 since the Small Seal script; however, in the conservative variant 𨵑, the two hands and the latch are well visible.

Compare 闢. See also 關, in which the door is kept shut by two wooden poles.
entries.閏: Compound ideogram: 門 (gate) + 王 (king). The original meaning “intercalary” is derived from kings' ancient practice of remaining within the palace gates on a leap day (which was in excess of the lunar calendar's 364 days, whence the meanings “remainder” and “surplus”), not engaging in their usual governing functions.
entries.閑: Compound ideogram: 門 (door) + 木 (wood) – a fence.
entries.閒:
Simplified from 間.

Compound ideogram: 門 (door) + 月 (moon) – moonlight peeking through a door – interstice; space (original character of 間).
entries.間: Variant form of 閒 with 月 replaced by 日.
entries.閔: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (gate, semantic) + 文 (phonetic)
entries.閘: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (gate, semantic) + 甲 (phonetic).
entries.閡: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (gate, semantic) + 亥 (phonetic).
entries.関:

The modern Japanese usage is of reform (shinjitai) nature.
entries.閣: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (gate, semantic) + 各 (phonetic).
entries.閤: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (door, semantic) + 合 (phonetic).
entries.閨: Compound ideogram: 門 (door, semantic) + 圭 (pointed jade tablet, phonetic) – arched door in the shape of a 圭.
entries.閩: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (phonetic) + 虫 (snake, semantic). The 虫 radical was a common component of the names of barbarians, probably reflecting the Min people's worship of snakes.
entries.閪: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (door, semantic) + 西 (phonetic). Compare 𨳊, 𨳍, 𨶙.
entries.閭: Phono-semantic compound: 門 (gate, semantic) + 呂 (phonetic).
